story_mappings.introduction: Explore several independent forests, inns, ruins and outposts under one Mini Zones journal. Follow three accepted requests or stories and four supporting armor recipes. Current materials and earlier exchanges explain possible routes, without requiring personal recovery. Active, ready accounting is required.
orientation: The ruined city, Broken Blade tavern and ruined outpost each have working Surface Realm approaches. Discovering one part opens this shared journal; it does not prove you have visited every mini-area. Several other boundary exits point to absent rooms and need a reviewed repair.

At the Broken Blade tavern, the dishwasher in the kitchen complains about waittress. Her actual tip jar is carried by the young waitress in the dining room. The accepted jar delivery reveals a cutpurse clue, without an item, money or experience reward.

Upstairs, the enchanted eastern door accepts the spoken word cutpurse. Speech unlocks it, after which opening the door and travelling through it are separate actions. The guild and fence beneath the tavern have no additional static quest terminal.

In the ruined city, ask the groaning spirit and forgotten knight about driedel. The knight also responds to worach. A parchment addressed to him releases his current appearance and supplies a blue-green strip; there is no implemented Gaffin escort or king-defeat finale.

The secret downward passage between the tower and intact building reaches a chamber with a black wall. Enter that wall for the Maze of Souls. From its entry, east, south, east, east, west, south, east, east reaches the secret passage. Continue east and south twice to the magical cache.

The pale revenant in that cache carries a small closed satchel with the release parchment. Open the accessible bag and take the actual letter. Return through the maze and white-wall exit; searching, reading or entering the maze alone does not deliver the letter.

Restore the silver sword with one silvery-blue strip from the skulk, one blue-green strip from the knight, one silvery-green strip from the Bodak, and the hidden golden hilt in the musk creeper's bulb. Three same-named strips are still different kinds.

The old wise man lives in a forest hut reached through the hole in the city wall. Offer all four pieces together. A supplied set skips any earlier producer history. The sword has a separate wielded combat power; receiving it does not prove the power triggered or affected an enemy.

The well-kept shop has a concealed locked panel. One unseen servant carries its tiny golden key; the panel holds two helpful potions. This preparation is optional, and is distinct from the sword pieces and the released knight's receipt.

At the ruined outpost, the quartermaster stocks ghostly sleeves, pants, gloves and boots. The battlemaster above the sparring hall describes four actual upgrades, each requiring its matching base, five huge blood crystals and 400 platinum. The payment recipes are currently unavailable.

Huge blood crystals have ground sources across the Surface Realm. Five separate crystals and the matching ghostly piece must be ready together for each recipe. Completing an armor service earns its own output, without a story or daily achievement.

The outpost's hidden storage niche holds a durethium key for the torturer's hidden lockbox. The burnt cell has a secret western crawlspace. Key access, lockbox loot and the armor recipes remain independent routes.

The Elvengrove tree doorway uses an oaken key from the wayhouse traveller. Its ancient desk uses a different metallic loop worn by the dryad princess. The current charm and teleport behavior needs further qualification before a personal rescue objective.

The wayhouse, pond, minotaur home, worm nest, inn and ruined city offer independent exploration. Names, drawings, companion plaques, a black monolith and gambling furnishings are lore leads; they do not create automatic learned-topic, game-win or cleared-area achievements.

The inn reception sells an obsidian room key; the actual rental room is upstairs. The wayhouse pet service draws from the adjacent barn rather than the separately labelled storage room. Pet purchases, rentals and claims are unavailable pending payment qualification.

The potash miner at the tavern bar hosts a separate random world-quest service. The nearby elderly bartender does not have that assignment. Those generated tasks retain their own quest system and are not extra static Mini Zones stories.

The checklist records supplies and accepted exchanges. Claimed ranks, personal kills, discovered clues and opened locks need their own evidence before becoming earned stages.

story_mappings.introduction: Follow the Way of the Faerie to Finn and Anna's cottage, then connect the living tree's heart to the ruined elven temple. Finn's signet and key and Celriya's family blade have distinct accepted outcomes. The glowing-ring and five-plane forge trades are supporting services. Active, ready accounting is required.
orientation: The side path from the mainland forest enters a looping enclosure. Find the southern hidden path from the large clearing, then follow it east through the foliage to the Way. The ordinary mainland return is west from that side path.

Meet Finn at the choice of directions below the hill. His native anna, ring/home and key/castle topics connect local routes without learned-keyword achievements. The dwarf and mischievous forest inhabitants are separate encounters.

Travel up and over the hill, then through the highland forest path to Anna's living oak cottage. Read the upstairs library entries for the lost city, Celriya and Finn. Anna has no addressed quest topics; her description points to this library.

The library advertises an orb return. Touch the actual orb to reach the realm's side path; travel west from there to the mainland forest. Orbs are also declared in the cottage heart. Touching is a travel action, not Finn's departure or an automatic quest milestone.

For a personal cottage route, Anna holds the white-metal key fitting the cellar trapdoor. The dangerous tunnels contain roots, no-magic sections and a floorless shaft. The tree spirit starts in an equipment load room and can wander into its chamber, where it blocks down while present.

Recover the tree spirit's worn signet for Finn. The accepted return gives a map and glowing ring. This preserves Finn's existing delivery and does not magically send him home. The spirit's amulet is a key for the temple tomb, not proof you killed it yourself.

The old southern roadway reaches the ruined city and temple garden. Say peace at its magical gate to unlock it, then open it. The two reflecting pools describe Oberon's final battle and Celriya's loss through static room text; they do not transport you into the past.

The ancient sword in the cottage heart is Tvelor's family artifact. A tablet in the goblin's junk heap explains the connection. Bring the sword to Celriya for faerie-sight goggles and her restoration wand; she retires after acceptance. The goggles are a reward, without a reviewed mandatory quest gate.

Carry or hold the tree spirit amulet to unlock the temple tomb slab. Oberon carries Finn's mammoth castle key. Returning that key gives Finn's sword and 500,000 copper and retires his current appearance; no earlier ring exchange is required.

Finn calls his other input a teleport scroll, but his binding actually consumes the glowing ring for a map and 500 copper. Fulbar's shop wall also describes a bulky travel scroll, while the actual stocked scroll identifies items. These content discrepancies await deliberate builder correction.

Two forge makers accept all five distinct planar parts and 5,000,000 copper for the same Fix scroll. They start in a dispersal network and can wander into distant areas. Item checks explain supplies; active accounting currently refuses the paid recipe until supported settlement.

Fix repairs the condition of one selected carried or equipped item in a separate scroll action. A maker receipt, a Moradin gift, an epic-store purchase or a supplied scroll does not prove you repaired something or recovered the five parts personally.

The library's golden-gate riddle is still an undetermined placeholder, and the gate has no destination. The lost Song, Mab's earlier restoration and waiting for Oberon to return also have no accepted local ending. Keep these as lore until builders choose implemented outcomes.

Current supplies remain optional preparation. Gifts are valid native inputs; previous receipts explain history without replacing spent materials. Only accepted native exchanges complete these named deliveries, and active sources, travel and recipient availability still need qualification.

story_mappings.introduction: Shairak's villagers remember dragon tribute, broken families and a shaman's curse. Explore Smokeveil's forest, caves, burrow and lake for the exact proofs each contact accepts. Their exchanges and reward choices remain separate.
orientation: Start in Shairak: Ivar, Dorno, Keebo, Raltron, Tarlator and Ilvorntas live or work around the village paths. Oystein and Forvos wait in the tavern. Ordinary closed cottage, inn and shop doors can be opened.
Ask Ivar about sanrabb, dolgar, svartalo and the lottery to understand the village conflict. His heart reward needs both hearts together; his separate talon reward also makes him leave.

Enter the dragon cave from the forest's big-cave entrance. Dargast carries the pile of scales, Sanrabb his heart, Svartalo the bloody talon, and Dolgar his heart and the large scale. Azcatlipoca waits in the hatchery.
Beneath the sparse brush, follow the hole into the rabbit warren for Xertrath. Keebo wants the bunny master's head, not another rabbit or a general corpse.
The Tentabeast waits in the southern lake. Prepare for water travel and check your return route. The lake and forest paths also lead back to the surrounding lands.
Read the parchment in Tarlator's house and ask about his human curse, offer, heart, scrolls and Raltron. The parchment is readable scenery; you do not need to carry a quest scroll for his exchange.

Choose how to spend trophies. Ivar, Tarlator and Ilvorntas each consume a bloody talon. Tarlator and Ilvorntas each consume a Tentabeast heart. Completing every request needs three talons and two hearts from separate available supplies.

Tarlator's helm can then be delivered to Raltron. Each exchange has its own reward; supplied materials and a supplied helm qualify. A reward from an earlier step does not replace an item you have already spent.

For Oystein's betrayal request, the head named Grishnak has a known carrier in Tezcat: Diabolus in the ruined-temple catacombs. Return the exact trophy to Shairak. The local delivery does not establish a personal foreign kill.

Ravi Bjornson in Alatorin describes Ivar as his father and seeks vengeance for his injuries. His separate request consumes a Tentabeast heart and a Bloodbeast heart from Raxthan; reserve another heart if following that story.
Recover the actual dead animal in the forest for Azcatlipoca; the charred tree's animal description is scenery. Forvos accepts Otsurd's whiskey bottle, pays a coin reward and remains available.

Most request contacts leave after rewarding you. Check their presence and trophy availability before attempting another exchange. Their family histories and promised cures are guidance; these deliveries do not establish a reunion, transformation or every conversation.

story_mappings.introduction: Welcome to the Plains of Life. Follow the signs to learn the basics before entering the world.
orientation: Follow the trail north, east, east, north, east, and east. Use look sign at each tutorial sign.
The first two signs offer armor and bless when examined with look sign. These are optional aids, not recorded journal achievements.
Practice attributes, score, wear all, equipment, skills, innates, and help commands as the signs and rooms explain.
Meet the paladin and ask paladin racewars or ask paladin racewar. New arrivals need this conversation before entering the Life Stream.
At the end of the trail, use enter stream to travel to Ailvio. Sword possession does not open the stream; the tutorial state does.

story_mappings.introduction: Discover the city, meet its circus, court, shrine, bartender and monastery contacts, then follow six independent accepted stories. Exact supplies and optional earlier help explain each route. Ramous and Lozin offer supporting services. Active, ready accounting is required.
orientation: The ordinary gravel-highway approach enters north at the southern edge of Verspin. Its brass doorway is closed but unkeyed; open it for the market. The southern city exit returns to the same highway approach.

Explore the circus in the west. Its northwestern tent has a hidden eastern path to the backstage network and Tottan. The five travelling gnomish shamans carry five same-kind totems; the accepted delivery, rather than five personal kills, earns his pants and XP.

Take an apple from either market stall for Ramous in the throne room. He exchanges it for a steak bone. Give that bone to the golden lion for its collar and departure. A supplied bone skips the apple route; those two receipts remain separate.

At the shrine, the holyman asks for five marble symbols from Tharnadian clerics. His suggested persuasion has no accepted keyword or symbol-transfer stage. His retiring delivery is the story outcome, and the other wandering cleric's insignia is a different item.

Vulm's stolen amethyst actually loads on a notorious jewel thief in the Cheltenham castle area, with a one-in-three chance and cap one. His crabmen clue needs correction. Return the exact gem for three distinct ore pieces; no separate gem-shop restoration is recorded.

Transo's Swinging Star is on the spectator level, reached by the city's western or eastern stairs. It needs no gladiator-pit key. Bring one green, one red and one black amulet for a belt and XP; his plan is to sell the stolen goods to Ramous, without an implemented reunion.

Red and green amulets each share a cap of three across their actual town/boatman sources. Black amulets have a separate cap and sources. Lozin's knife competes for reds and blacks; his four-red shield recipe exceeds the reviewed ordinary red cap and needs a deliberate feasibility correction.

Lozin has five actual paid equipment recipes. The sign prototype advertises ten, with no ordinary sign reset and no contracts for the other five offers. Keep the five real recipes as services; their cash settlement remains unavailable with active accounting. Brial also stocks all five outputs.

The master monk asks for one sigil of corruption from Bloodstone. Three sinister apprentices start together in Maelborg's tower, but only one ordinary sigil is declared after the third. The delivery belongs to Verspin and does not prove every apprentice or tower leader was defeated.

The secured pit uses two distinct keys from the strong and elite security guards. Reverse gate sides are merely closed. Guard taunts do not add a custom movement barrier. Hidden cave and shaft routes have their own access and falling hazards; they are not Transo prerequisites.

The waterways use ordinary deep-water movement. A carried or worn leaf boat is one aid; flight and other native movement abilities can also work. Boatmen's ambient offers do not implement a quest ferry, and no boating milestone is inferred from their dialogue.

Shinjin's nine listed stat potions are virtual paid stat effects, with native stat caps, rather than collectible quest objects. The normal teachers, inn and crew room are separate services. They need qualified settlement/effect evidence before any deeper lesson, purchase or hiring objective.

The city's honor, fighting, secret agents and blessings provide exploration lore without native contest-victory, spy-purge or blessing receipts. Asking topics explains current stories; it does not grant learned-keyword achievements. Native XP declarations remain subject to level and group award policy.

steps.hint: Five travelling gnomish shamans start around the town and market, sharing a five-totem cap. They can wander. Supplied totems qualify, without proof of who defeated each shaman.
steps.text: Carry five gnomish totems

steps.text: Deliver five totems to Tottan

stories.summary: Ask the holyman about his purpose. He requests five marble holy symbols associated with visiting Tharnadian clerics. story_mappings.introduction: Explore Torg's captive city through council secrets, legendary relics and the dwarven invasion. Each accepted delivery is a separate accomplishment; supplied materials can skip preparation.
orientation: Begin with Kordor and the Keeper for the hide and favor routes. The woman's token exchange supplies a rose for Zuzon; the jeweler accompanies Zarina.
The Colosseum's locked entrance answers to the spoken word carnage. The champion's medallion unlocks the upper council route before Zillra accepts it as an offering.
Zillra asks you to destroy the two promise rings. Zojt instead rewards delivery of both distinct rings; that is the recorded affair exchange.
The Lore Keeper accepts all eight distinct legendary relics together. His three Tranug commissions are separate and need neither the eight-relic delivery nor a recorded kill.
Timoro's death calls down the dwarven invasion force. Dranar and the accepting buckle craftsman arrive with that force; their availability depends on its actual arrival.
The legend scroll and Lanella's randomly created heart lead to quests outside Torg. A transformed scroll or a supplied heart does not establish a Torg achievement.

Optional curing, favor, rose and locket history explains preparation without blocking supplied terminal materials. Ask the contacts about the listed topics; learning a topic alone earns no achievement.

story_mappings.introduction: Learn your way around Ailvio, help its families, and choose the requests offered by the teachers you meet.
orientation: Start with Burbul: ask burbul hello, info, quest, or map. Look at the map to locate the guilds.
A letter of introduction can be exchanged for a teacher's starter equipment. These supply services are separate from their quests.
Try one local story: feed the hungry family; bring medicine to the grandmother; or recover Silva's stolen voice.
Explore with look, exits, and search. Some materials are hidden, carried by creatures, or inside containers. Current possession does not prove how you obtained an item.
The archway in the glowing temple leads to a hometown chosen by your race and class. Prepare before leaving Ailvio.

story_mappings.introduction: Explore the grove's linked crafting stories: Striker's robes, Xaves' piwafwi and Valin's Mage Bane. Preparation services explain their ingredients; feeding the two birds is a separate pair of requests.
orientation: Use look and exits, and meet visible people to reveal their requests. The checklist shows current supplies and recorded exchanges; conversation alone earns no achievement.
From the Homestead pond, stare statue reaches the grove's large open branch. The Solonar statue on that branch returns to the Homestead. Arrival discovers only the zone actually reached.
Touch pedestal by the swallow returns to the western glades; stare circle by the hawk returns to the inner circle. The paired soot discs respond to tap disc and link the glades with the caverns.

In the merchant branches, stare at Sehanine's statue to reach the other side. Follow the elemental circle for the centaur's six different recipe ingredients. Hidden circle passages may need discovery and opening.

The Point's north passage responds to say arrow, then opening. The inner circle's locked south passage responds to say solonor; the hawk's circle offers another route. The centaur's hidden north passage is currently unlocked.
Enter opening from the northwestern path to approach the lich, or from the other northern path to approach the deep dragon. Examine the local exits and keep the return route in view.
High tree branches can cause falls. Flight or levitation can protect you; active climbing may catch a slip. Learning a password or taking a route is guidance here, not a recorded story stage.

Some recipes consume the same ingredients. Reserve separate orbs, buckskin, panther hides, raw golden thread and filament when pursuing several stories. Supplied ingredients qualify without personal acquisition history.
Valin and the miner roam from an area outside ordinary entry routes and can enter a holding room. Check whether they are present. The hawk's ordinary mouse-recovery route needs repair.

Diamond repair, arch-magi robes and the piwafwi include coin fees and are currently unavailable until mixed payments are supported. Other listed coin amounts are rewards. Preparation alone does not complete an equipment story.

story_mappings.introduction: Longhollow is under siege while a protected temple, woodland campsite and witch's shrine offer separate routes. The mayor's five-proof delivery leads to a physical bracer for Solar. The witch's potion and poison experiments have independent intermediate hand-ins and distinct physical-output finales. Clothing services and scene lore remain separate.
orientation: Follow the forest path into the tall grass. The campsite beside the brook holds the trapper and traders; the stone shrine holds the witch. Trampled grass leads southeast to the ruined parish, its enemy leaders and Selune's temple.

Speak to the mayor in the clearing north of the parish. His proof set contains five distinct heads: the Bloodied Knight, necromancer, Fomorian chieftain, enchantress and dark priest. One head kind cannot replace another. The proof items are chance-loaded carried stock, not a reviewed personal-death achievement.

The knight and captive wife are upstairs in the mansion; the necromancer is at the burning stable and the dark priest chants in Market Square. The hidden briar route west of the grass leads through rock paths and a boulder entrance to the chieftain and enchantress in the caverns. Listed panels and doors reset open; no magical belt or glove gate is implemented here.

The mayor awards both the Longhollow bracer and an exquisite moonstone. Solar in Selune's inner sanctum accepts only the physical bracer for a star woven symbol, then disappears. Earlier mayor history is optional; a supplied bracer qualifies, while a moonstone or a spent-bracer receipt does not.

The witch narrates potion recipes in order, but each exact hand-in matches independently. Keep the distinct red, green and bubbling vials for the mist combination with the blood drop. The bubbling-vial recipe also rewards 25,000 copper through the supported native reward path; it charges no fee. Supplied exact outputs can feed the later recipe without producer history.

For the poison branch, two venom sacs plus mandrake produce a filled root; lotus, nightshade and red mushroom produce a filled head. Both prepared outputs plus the exact loose Kiss of Talona bloom complete the final blend. The nearby rooted vine is scenery, and the finished leaf's advertised poison behavior needs content review.

The trapper makes caps, boots, scarves, cloaks and a rare five-material headdress. Native boots cost 20 gold despite dialogue saying 15. Paid clothing is currently unavailable under active accounting. Four snake skins, two fox furs and two venom sacs exceed their respective ordinary cap-one supply; availability needs repair rather than a promise to wait for another reset.

Stock may be missing or carried by other players, and native NPCs may wander. Harv's shop remains implemented behind the alley panel despite his packing dialogue. Temple survivors, the captive wife, decorative corpses and Rolane's empty quest placeholder have no reviewed rescue, recovery or siege-ending completion.

Carry every offering directly, outside equipment or containers. Exact current supplies show readiness; an accounting-backed delivery records that hand-in once. Questions, optional producer receipts and printed promises do not confirm a personal kill, all-stage campaign, learned spell, title flag, rescue or applied item effect.

story_mappings.introduction: Explore Newhaven's living streets and their corrupted counterpart. The blacksmith's loss connects the rift to a real recovery request; berries and lost tobacco have separate deliveries. Equipment and the mismatched pipe trade remain services. The rift, librarian and prisoner have unfinished lore. Active, ready accounting is required.
orientation: Enter from the Tharnadia Highway and meet the living blacksmith, baker, armorer and plump Dibbly. Only the blacksmith and armorer have addressed quest topics. Ambient messages elsewhere explain leads without learned-keyword achievements.

The tear in reality on Newhaven Way leads to the ruined city. Its southern street also returns toward Newhaven Way. The two cities have separate NPC prototypes; killing a counterpart does not transform the living citizen or end the curse.

Search the decaying armory for the zombie assistant carrying the blacksmith's mummified wife. Return the remains to the living blacksmith for 50,000 XP. That accepted delivery answers his loss without resurrecting her or closing the rift.

Newhaven blackberries have ground declarations in the ruined bakery and a northern ruined Rapture Way dead end. Bring one bunch to the living baker for 18,000 XP. Both locations share a live cap of two; the spectre does not accept the delivery.

Recover the ground tobacco pouch in the ruined general store for the living Dibbly's 3,500-copper reward. An erinyes can appear there on a separate 25-percent reset; her death is not required by the exchange.

Dibbly asks for fishing line but his other current binding consumes a snorkel pipe for 5,000 copper. The actual reel has a different item identity. Read this trade as a support service until its intended recipe is resolved; it does not craft a fishing rod.

The armorer offers two dark-circle badges with different fees and rewards, a lizard-tail bracer and a displacer-hide cloak. Exact current material checks help preparation; paid offerings remain unavailable with active accounting until supported settlement. One circle cannot satisfy both badge recipes.

The tail stock belongs only to one small-lizard appearance in the northern ruined Rapture Way dead end. The displacer skin is carried by a beast that starts in a mainland forest distribution room and can wander through several woodland exits. These sources are not general animal harvesting rules.

Enter the waterfall beside the living gate to visit Vulgaris's damp cave. Read its sign for the frayed Khomani-Khan collar, Mixt's heart and 100,000 copper recipe. Supplied materials qualify; the fee still requires supported accounting settlement.

Touch the library painting in each city's scribing room to enter that city's library. Ordinary paths out remain in the same city. Both Evelosi appearances and the erinyes provide lore, but no implemented investigation, confession or rift-closure outcome exists.

The living and ruined Artos each carry a black CELL key. Both locked cells use it. The chained Dibbly asks for death, but opening his door, killing him or paying the living merchant does not record a rescue. Key access is a useful route, without a current quest endpoint.

The living sewer grate leads to western mainland forest; its ruined counterpart leads to eastern hills. Fountain and statue signs explain local law and faith without accepted-action objectives. Rent at the ruined inn uses shared inn rules; it is not the living innkeeper's quest.

Current items and an optional earlier Fisherman's Wharf receipt explain preparation. Gifts remain valid inputs; possession does not prove recovery, a kill or harvest. Completion follows an accepted terminal exchange, and active source generation still needs qualification.

story_mappings.introduction: Investigate a missing adventurer beneath the fortress inn, recover three royal proofs and release captives. Nine independent outcomes sit beside seven support exchanges. Optional sources and history explain a journey without requiring personal recovery. Active, ready accounting is required.
orientation: The fortress has a surface approach and an Underdark tunnel entrance. Discovery opens this journal; stories and named contacts still depend on physical encounters. Administrative access is not an ordinary player entrance.

A stolen silver chalice earns an inn-bed clue. The inn also has addressed conversation about a barbarian moving a bed. These are alternate information leads, without an enforced briefing or learned-keyword achievement.

Shoving the inn sleeping-room bed clears its blocked secret downward route. A boulder below operates the upward return. Search and ordinary door state remain separate actions; neither successful access nor travel is recorded as quest history yet.

An adventurer corpse before the underground waterfall contains the bloodstained note and salt-water vials. This preplaced container is different from an actor death witnessed by the player. Taking or reading its contents alone does not finish a request.

The bloodstained-note delivery and three-proof royal finale are independent outcomes. The final proof set is an exact head, balanced longsword and gold hair pin. Supplied materials fit without a briefing, personal kill, full crafting chain or recorded escort.

The goblin leader carries a small silver key used by a locked chest and two captives. One rescue returns a replacement key with experience; the other consumes it for a gold hair pin. Check current custody before each delivery; a receipt is not another key.
A separate beaten prisoner wants the set of cell keys. This rescue also returns replacement keys with experience. Both key-return rescues count for zone progress and are not offered as daily quests.

The trainer's proof uses the decorated goblin totem and dark amulet, producing the balanced longsword. A crafted bullywug totem, ordinary goblin sword or earthen statue cannot substitute. Delivering the proof does not establish a personal kill.

A support chain runs from two distinct hides and a fee to a statue, then gourd plus statue and another fee to a totem, ring, buckler, rod and dark amulet. The two mixed-fee services remain guarded under active accounting; supplied later materials can still support independent deliveries.

A separate feather-headband service requires exact peryton feathers, gorilla hide and a fee. The relevant animals are captive locally despite distant homeland dialogue. This mixed service is guarded and creates no quest achievement.

The captain's strange note and the corpse's bloodstained note are different kinds. The strange-note delivery gives a hidden-shop key; the captain separately accepts a hemp necklace and peace pipe for fifty platinum. Direction dialogue does not create the carried note.

The underwater treasure chest is a push-operated switch rather than loot storage. It reveals a diagonal passage with an Underdark connection. Boulders at that tunnel currently target an already-open east route, so their shove action has no effect.

A mysterious key carried by the goblin shaman opens the concealed pool/platform connection. Standing at either blue-chalk inscription teleports between the platform and a spy chamber beside the royal room; the configured portals have unlimited charges. Destination and accepted travel still need live qualification.

Ordinary shops, room rental, teaching and a special sword's pegasus call follow their own rules. Other prisoners, animal cages and captive-centaur lore have no additional accepted rescue contracts here. Departure prose does not prove arrival home, invasion or settlement clearance.

story_mappings.introduction: Discover the ports, meet their contacts and follow nineteen independent commissions: local supplies, overseas proof and exact mixed collections. Six supplier and equipment services stay separate. Active, ready accounting is required.
orientation: Canderthal, Fenaline and Thur'Gurax have separate loaded land approaches from the Surface Realm. Visiting one discovers this shared area, but other contacts remain hidden until encountered. No ship ownership or sailing receipt is required for the native deliveries.

Start with dock supply recovery and the seafood kitchens. Chundel and Grimashk pay different prices for normal crates; Grimashk also accepts old reinforced crates as one recovery alternative. Voshen and Martinek each need six of their own exact seafood kind.

Pol sells an ordinary fishing pole separately from his refunded briefing. His final lure request consumes five shells and five fire glands, pays cash and XP, and does not require his note or award Fishfetcher. Optional current supplies and earlier history do not add achievements.

Crendethyl wants the engraved stein equipped by the huge bartender in Canderthal. Elthindeal wants the Canderthal ale cask from Gringash's cellar. Carry their actual proofs between the ports; tavern dialogue and visits provide guidance without enforced prior stages.

The turtle, pyrolisk, viper, panther, samurai, hydralisk and bandit sources disperse into distinct mainland regions. Their caps, worn proof and current roaming locations need active qualification. One pyrolisk branch is unloaded and one viper destination is ocean. Supplied materials remain valid.

Gringash and Kruth'Urgur want the same tinker map for different independent purposes and payments. Gelden wants a Sarmiz obsidian and steel totem; Shaenae wants the aged ring from a foreign bone pile; Frull wants a Werrun cigar box. The delivery receipt belongs to this port area even when its source is elsewhere.

Krintis, Ayden and Vrash compete for venom, glands or panther teeth. Trismerk needs five jade katanas; Austugus needs five hydralisk glands. Cairme's implemented recipe needs four shivs and the exact tundra rations despite a conflicting six-shiv line. These research and military commissions do not implement poison, antidote, siege or arsenal state.

Bestile needs six distinct potion kinds, one each. The troll in Thur'Gurax stocks his brown potion locally as well as all three Bronak materials. Exact supplies can come from shops, alternate sources or other players; their possession does not prove first personal acquisition or visiting every named shop.

Bronak's three totems each require one exact material and fifty platinum. His outputs differ from Gelden's proof. The refunded briefing, two seafood purchases and three totem recipes remain support services with guarded coin settlement.

Closed port gates are unkeyed. The barracks east door is reset locked with key zero; ordinary lock-picking and other valid access need qualification. A hidden cellar staircase connects to a foreign gambling room. Loaded sea edges use ocean movement; three other legacy port exits are unloaded and need deliberate repair.

Worshipping the garden statue and touching the storm altar use ordinary teleport objects with walking return routes. The moonwell enters Shaledrieth. These actions, teachers suggested by prose, inns, ship construction and crew hiring have no new quest milestones without accepted event evidence. Paid ship services also need coordinated accounting settlement.

Quest rewards preserve actual cash, items, declared XP and recipient retirement. Native XP is subject to actor and companion caps. Gifts can prepare a valid turn-in without recording personal hunting, fishing, sailing, faction standing, learned keywords or a whole campaign.

story_mappings.introduction: The Lost Temple of Tikitzopl tells of a resistance against the Krahns and undead. Follow the hidden magician, Zynar's guards' key, four guardian shards and the glass component toward royal treasure and the Orb of Insanity; O'Gallagher and the beautiful drow have separate requests. Item deliveries establish their exact outcomes, while lore, travel, combat and temple liberation need separate evidence. Active, ready accounting is required.
orientation: The temple entrance lies below the Lost City's forest entrance. The foreign temple key opens the approach door; its sacrifice contract remains owned by the Lost City. The magically sealed northern door in the entrance description is scenery: the actual temple route is the hidden trapdoor down.

Look for the hidden chamber beneath the Necromancy temple to meet the crafty magician. Ask about mages, list or help and examine the room journal for the resistance plan. The separate empty Ancient Crypt below the necromancy altar is not his ordinary placement.

The large golem in the hidden passage carries the flaming key for the secret fire-side wall. Krahn'krayv equips the armor of the elements in the Temple of Meditation. Give that exact armor to Zynar at the Altar of Dexterity for the wooden guards' key.

The guards' training grounds contain the master of arms and the glass component. A gem-and-gold key is declared inside a cot in the guards' sleeping chambers and opens the king's chambers. The rack instead contains two yellow vials; its own keyed closure uses that same gem key.

The earth, water, fire and air guardians carry four different shards. Bring one of each plus the glass component to the magician for the golden treasure key. The glass component is a recipe ingredient; a fire shard is different from the separately collected burning flame.

Push the majestic royal altar, then use the golden key for its locked passage down to the treasure rooms. Pushing clears the block but does not itself unlock or reveal all access. This key has a one-percent native break chance; the other local access keys have no native break chance.

Altar inscriptions are clues to the sequence of magical speech doors beyond the treasure rooms. Their accepted last-word keywords differ by door; examined lore and successful unlocking are not recorded as journal achievements. The final southern door is already open in its loaded state.

The Orb is declared inside the marble high altar beyond those doors. Each of fifteen chosen Orb enhancements consumes a separate Orb together with its exact ingredients. One Orb cannot complete every upgrade, and an earlier key or crafting receipt cannot replace a spent current ingredient.

The high altar room also has a separate entrance from Winterhaven's gnomish-key teleport room. Entering its array of lights leads to the Lost City Snake Pit, where a ground leaf key opens the exit. This is a one-way return route with its own encounter, source and travel qualification; hints do not award foreign discovery.

Nine distinct emblems merge into the empowering emblem; nine distinct earrings merge into the Krahns earring. Five sharp stone pieces, ten standard swords, four guard scimitars, five claymores or five base glistening bracelets make separate magical base outputs. Carry every required piece together for the chosen recipe.

Four weather components merge into the basic weathered shard. Four different royal dagger metals and three royal sword metals make their own bases. Those bases can then compete for an Orb; donated exact bases skip earlier producer receipts.

Advanced services also use Lost City equipment: eight distinct racial flesh rings, three different same-named sapphire necklaces and High Council weapons. Necklace sources and attributes distinguish the three kinds. Stocked rings and weapons do not establish personal creature kills or body-part creation.

Return the clover necklace from the drow warrior to O'Gallagher for the mirrored bracelet; give that bracelet to the beautiful drow for mirrored leggings. These two requests remain independent, and donated exact offerings work without the earlier local request.

The high altar prayer is a separate class-change service: it can remove a multiclass character's secondary class and specialization for 100 epic points. Its debit already waits for committed settlement. It grants no quest credit and is not required to retrieve the Orb or craft equipment.

MaDMaN armor can use its worn hide power, the shield has a fire retaliation, the mangler has blur/riposte powers and the mace uses a worn mentality command with a five-minute cooldown. An early mace repeat hurts the wielder. These powers do not complete a takeover, reveal a learned quest keyword or prove accepted combat progress.

Directly carry every exact offering outside equipment and containers. Readiness and journal reads award nothing. Four named requests/story assemblies are potential daily candidates; the 25 equipment services and class-change prayer award no quest achievements or dailies. Fresh active reset stock and actual travel/combat/service episodes still need qualification.

story_mappings.introduction: Winterhaven connects everyday city requests with forest crafts, prisoners, snow-ogre passages, ambassador memories and distant artifact expeditions. Choose a story and follow its exact materials and named contact.
orientation: Read look, exits and the signs along the guild district. Ask named contacts about their listed topics; talking gives clues, while completed deliveries appear in your history.
For wildlife, recover the freshly killed animal item. Grenthal buys it; Monfit tans it for crafting. Selling and tanning consume the same item, so choose its use before delivery.
Most fresh animal remains spoil. Carry them promptly to the intended maker; an ordinary corpse or a decayed carcass cannot replace the requested fresh item.
For alchemy, bring each Incarnate material and an empty potion bottle to Bipplewizzlille. The five resulting potions can fund either his elixir or Chibbleniffle's separate potion request.
For equipment, obtain blueprints from Chibbleniffle, plain equipment from the weapon or armory merchant, and the named ingot from the blacksmith merchant. Each improvement consumes another blueprint.
Sootfoot then needs the exact improved equipment, an orb of binding, a weapon hilt or armor flint, and his recipe's distant artifacts. These are independent commissions.
For silk, Grendilyn exchanges the two rare fabrics for two raw threads. Melfist colors a raw thread with the named dye; Seyb needs the matching leather garment, colored thread and payment.
The ambassador memory requests reward a shopkeepers token, a strange enchantment scroll and coins. Scrolls become a random attribute; Branay needs two matching attribute scrolls per earring.
For the prison and palace, ask Rosenthal, Thyz and Sir Espet about their requests. The immunity letter, prison key and palace key have different purposes.
To reach the snow-ogre realm, stare at Ohjal's painting. The chief trades a baby centaur for a key; that key breaks after unlocking one shaman door. Four freshly locked doors require four copies.
Ask Xola and Drahknalloth's projection about time and the dragons before their expedition. Carry the three beating hearts for the three locked seals, then deliver them before they decay.
Supplied materials count for native delivery. A completed delivery records the exchange; it does not establish a personal kill, learned topic, unlocked passage or complete campaign.

contacts.description: Exethanter wanders from the Amber Temple holding passage. Ask about his name and the crypts; Dostron is addressed by the native spelling dostran. His ash exchange and Thredra's ash exchange are independent choices.
contacts.name: Exethanter

contacts.description: Emil is the shackled Barovian in the keyed cells. Stefania's black key supplies his rescue; his werewolf departure is narrated.
contacts.name: Emil the Barovian

contacts.description: Thredra offers holy-relic and ash outcomes plus a fortune service. Her relic exchange retires her, so choose contact order carefully. The chanting word eugszr is an addressable response rather than a recorded spell.
contacts.name: Thredra Anarax

contacts.description: Kasimir offers the blood-of-Zhudun rescue story and a separate fortune service. His rescue retires him; the already stocked corpse and banshee in Patrina's crypt are independent world data.
contacts.name: Kasimir Velikov

contacts.description: The Vistani wagoner provides road, rumor and vampire guidance without a native terminal delivery.
contacts.name: a Vistani wagoner

contacts.description: Ezmerelda explains Vistani culture and twelve stateless card faces, offers an unsupported paid reading, and accepts the Strahd skull. Rahadin also requests her dagger; these routes share contact availability.
contacts.name: Ezmerelda D'avenir

contacts.description: Rahadin exchanges eight independent proofs for physical fortune coins, then offers four separate five-coin favor commissions. Printed invitations, court roles and vampire imagery do not establish faction membership.
contacts.name: Rahadin

contacts.description: Gadof Blinsky roams from the toyshop toward Barovia. One of five artifacts satisfies his recovery request. His carried toy woman can be sold by legacy shopping, though it is not replenishing shop stock; purchases are blocked under active accounting.
contacts.name: Gadof Blinsky

contacts.description: Rictavio can roam through the Ravenloft approach. His Strahd-skull reward differs from the other two recipients, and Rahadin accepts his bonnet as an independent proof.
contacts.name: Rictavio

contacts.description: Izek offers distinct wine, comb and toy requests, a fortune service and unsupported paid dues. His reward key has no confirmed access target. Use the native topic breech for his castle-breach response.
contacts.name: Izek Strazni

contacts.description: Cyrus Belview trades one fortune coin for four equipment chests, cash and experience, then disappears. This is a service rather than a separate story achievement.
contacts.name: Cyrus Belview

contacts.description: The image of Rahadin in the spectral corridor replaces the old catacomb key and awards the spectral key, then disappears. The old key and spectral key both have a 100 break chance.
contacts.name: an image of Rahadin

contacts.description: Jander offers a distinct Strahd-skull finale and raw-ant-pincer food service. Rahadin requests his Oathbow, so proof recovery and later availability need a conscious route choice.
contacts.name: Jander Sunstar

contacts.description: Stefania's spectre carries the black cell key needed by Emil. Possession does not prove a personal kill or a successful unlocking journey.
contacts.name: a spectre of "Stefania"

contacts.description: The animated cloak follows Rahadin with four different favor scrolls and also has a fixed-room shop role. Purchases are unavailable under active accounting; existing supplied stock remains valid for favor commissions.
contacts.name: Rahadin's animated cloak

contacts.description: Pidlwick II carries the exact clockwork artifact Blinsky accepts and roams from a release passage.
contacts.name: &-wPidlwick II

contacts.description: This specific windup gnome carries Blinsky's required artifact. The many other windup gnomes do not share that stock.
contacts.name: a miniature wind-up gnome

contacts.description: The giant spider carries the chelicerae requested by Rahadin and has a roaming release route.
contacts.name: a GIANT spider

contacts.description: Gulthias carries Rahadin's heart proof and can roam through foreign forest, castle and Barovia routes.
contacts.name: the Gulthias tree

contacts.description: The ant queen in the burrow carries a heavy eggsac for Rahadin and raw pincers for Jander. These are distinct requests.
contacts.name: the giant ant queen

contacts.description: Strahd's wolf form carries a wolf statuette and a memory switch. The configured get and touch mechanisms open release passages; the form is an independent reset placement.
contacts.name: Count Strahd (dire wolf form)

contacts.description: Strahd's human form carries a second memory switch. Its configured touch target opens a passage; no reviewed death transformation creates the other forms.
contacts.name: Count Strahd (human form)

contacts.description: Strahd's bat form carries the dimension-door object. Entering is a teleport mechanism requiring its own committed-travel qualification.
contacts.name: Count Strahd (bat form)

contacts.description: Strahd's gaseous form carries the crypt key and exact skull. It is independent reset stock, not verified lineage from a player killing the human form.
contacts.name: Count Strahd (gaseous form)

contacts.description: Patrina's banshee is already placed in her crypt behind the reforged-key door. This placement and Kasimir's already stocked corpse do not prove successful resurrection.
contacts.name: the banshee of Patrina Velikovna

story_mappings.introduction: The Ravenloft Catacombs weave independent prisoner rescues, relic recovery, fortune commissions and three Strahd-skull reward choices through a large network of crypts. Follow the contacts you encounter and keep their competing proofs and availability in mind. Player journal progress requires active, ready accounting.
orientation: Enter through Castle Ravenloft's cellar or Kingsmen route, or push the paired handprints between Ravenloft and the catacomb wine-cellar passage. These are world access mechanisms; discovering or reading about them does not record successful travel.

The black key carried by Stefania fits the cell doors and supplies Emil's release. The old Castle Ravenloft key fits the main gates and hidden wall route; it has a 100 break chance. The image of Rahadin replaces it and awards a separately brittle spectral key for the spectral corridor.

Pull the iron curtains for Thredra's laboratory route and push the broken wine racks for the cellar passage. Bring Thredra three different holy relics together for a buckler and stake; her relic delivery retires her.

Dostron's ashes can restore Exethanter's narrated memory or rejuvenate Thredra for a different reward. Neither route is required by the other. Identical slab/remains prototypes use a shared container lookup, so the intended crypt placement of several relics needs live qualification.

The bleeding slab opens the Amber Temple passage. Kasimir accepts the altar's blood of Zhudun for a key to Patrina's crypt and three moonbeam drops. The existing banshee and Kasimir corpse do not prove a resurrection event.

Rahadin offers eight independent proof requests. Each supplies one physical spectral fortune coin; these items are distinct from wallet currency. Proofs drawn from Ezmerelda, Rictavio or Jander compete with keeping those contacts available for their good-aligned skull rewards.

Each favor commission requires five fortune coins and one exact role scroll together. The animated cloak carries four different scrolls and also has a shop role. Active accounting currently blocks buying; supplied existing scrolls still qualify. Native giving enforces no class or faction prerequisite.

Fortune services consume one coin for potions or equipment chests plus cash and experience. These remain visible support deliveries without extra achievements. Ezmerelda's paid card reading and Izek's paid dues use wallet offerings and remain unavailable under active accounting.

Ezmerelda's twelve card faces form a conversational loop: raven, moon and mists lead through blood, rose and chalice to bat, mirror and gate, then castle, coffin and candelabra return to the opening faces. Replies are stateless; keywords do not complete quest steps or establish a paid reading session.

Blinsky accepts any one of five exact clockwork artifacts as a single recovery request. His stocked toy woman supports a separate Izek request. Izek also accepts two different wines and Ireena's comb for distinct rewards; his toy reward key has no confirmed door or container target.

Wolf, human, bat and gaseous Strahd forms are independently reset creatures. The wolf statuette, two memory switches, dimension door and coffin mechanisms provide alternate passage routes. The gaseous form carries the exact skull; receipt does not prove a personal kill or a sequence of transformations.

Choose a skull recipient: Ezmerelda, Rictavio or Jander. Their equipment rewards differ, and each contact disappears after delivery. Promised room keys, restored sunshine, party departure and permanent liberation are not corresponding native outputs or recorded world changes.

Explore the crypt names, coffin-and-lid escape switches, Tomescu's Blood Rift portals, Sergei's portcullis and marble sword, and Dhavit's speech door. Say dhavit from the northern side or utherlan from the southern side to unlock that door, then open it. Some Blood Rift portals release enemies instead of transporting you.

Sasha's journal describes the Dayheart and Sunsword as history and intended vampire preparation. It is optional lore, without a verified Dayheart destruction or Sunsword quest outcome. One skeleton search mechanism targets an absent exit, and Sasha's alternate epitaph switch has no ordinary placement; those routes need builder repair.

Carry all offering items directly. Readiness and optional earlier receipts award nothing. Eighteen repeatable story/request groups are potential daily candidates; mode-zero disappearing contacts are story-only. Daily eligibility does not promise available stock or contacts. Active source-generation support must be qualified for a playable journey.

story_mappings.introduction: Explore a mining village and its silverworking, gem cutting, jewelry setting and magical-necklace leads. All twelve native exchanges are support services, with no quest or daily achievements. Several advertised recipes disagree with their current contracts. Active, ready accounting is required; paid exchanges remain guarded.
orientation: Surface hills reach the village approach from the south and west; two southeastern mine exits connect to the Underdark. A further eastern branch points to an unavailable old-world destination. Check an actual open route before travel.

The intended crafting story runs from silver ore to five pure bars, a plain necklace, five cut gems, a set necklace and a rare platinum disc, then rainbow enchantment. Current recipes disagree with that sequence. This journal explains the actual exchanges and their blockers instead of promising the intended outcome.

Ten raw-gem kinds share a visible name and aliases. Silver ore and pure silver bars are separate kinds. Current material checks distinguish exact kinds and quantities; five interchangeable-looking gems need not satisfy a five-copy contract.

Ordinary and magical gem-set necklaces share a visible name. The magical kind holds rainbow charges and is currently created directly by the five-raw-gem service. A current receipt does not replace an unequipped necklace after it has been used or consumed.

Real gold ore and pyrite also share a visible name. Real gold and pyrite are separately declared in eastern ore shafts. Only real gold matches the current magic-shop contract, whose required disc is unavailable.

The disc rumor describes a ranger, forest and kobold suspicion. It does not establish an active foreign recovery route, item grant or personal-source achievement. A similarly described foreign disc has a different identity and cannot substitute in the current recipe.

Current carried-material checks are optional preparation aids. Supplied matching items fit without prior crafting, personal mining, a paid rumor or learned keywords. No check proves first recovery, and no service receipt earns a quest achievement.

All twelve paid native exchanges remain unavailable under active accounting. Carrying every visible material does not override the payment guard, missing disc or missing jewelry rewards. Recipe repairs and safe payment integration need qualification before a fresh journey.

Gem and ore declarations, merchant inventories and alternative foreign or random-effect sources are leads. Caps, actual stock, custody and accepted acquisition still matter. Ordinary skill mining is guarded while item accounting is active and is different from picking up predeclared ore.

Guild teaching, class gates, shops, room rental, town justice and guard keys are separate support systems. Four named guildguard prototypes have gate procedures but are not placed by local resets; the cleric teacher occupies his gate position. Access rules need a deliberate builder review.

The stable lists a cave-spider hireling in its adjacent storage room. Pet purchase, rental and claim operations are guarded under active accounting. The old claim path reports a return without restoring the pet and needs repair before it can support a quest step.

The dump is also guarded while accounting is active. Drunken chatter and janitor pickup are ambient behavior. Orc, giant, beast and mine danger descriptions contain no local accepted rescue, clearance or village-defense outcome.

story_mappings.introduction: Explore Torrhan's lost sailor, royal potion deliveries, dragon cloth and restored sword stories. Eight independent outcomes sit beside fourteen support exchanges and four refusals. Earlier producers and current materials explain routes without requiring personal recovery. Active, ready accounting is required.
orientation: The city has Surface Realm approaches at the stone highway, ship-store waters and eastern Rhanale Forest. Discovery opens this zone journal; named stories and contacts still depend on encounters. The administrative dispersal room is not an ordinary player entrance.

Aineila at the end of the pier and the wounded elf in the forest cabin describe the same engagement ring. A hidden forest key opens the stationary box in the loft. Take the exact ring from the box and give it to Aineila. Her departure narrates the reunion, without an implemented escort or cure.

Marthona in the hidden city room describes a green dragon and suspicious royal behavior. Green dragonscales produce fuzzy pink socks and a secret-beach clue. Translucent cloth is returned as wrong proof. The clue does not unlock an exit or prove travel.

The secret eastern route from the beach reaches ledges with configured falls. Ladder exits provide a return route. Finding or using these exits does not create journal history; their current state and hazards need actual travel qualification.

The owl lady lives in a hidden hollow tree off Rhanale Forest. The boy and curious halfling each consume her same white feather for independent rewards. Source caps and her potion-story retirement affect availability; neither request requires a personal kill.

The full yellow potion is hidden inside a laboratory shelf. The laboratory seashell exchange produces a purple potion and shark skin gloves, despite its random-potion wording. Blue and purple potions are refused by the owl; the half-empty yellow potion is also a different kind.

Full yellow potion to owl lady gives a princess seal and half-empty yellow potion, then removes her current appearance. Half-empty potion to King Torrhan gives a reward crown and keeps him present. Either delivery accepts supplied material without requiring the other receipt or a Zrilxa kill.

The potion dialogue describes a princess rescue and royal cure. Those accepted exchanges record their exact materials and rewards. No persistent princess replacement, king cure, escort, demon defeat or returned-home state is implemented by these recipes.

The palace entry guard carries the iron gate key. A particular guardian enchantress carries the golden key for the throne-level hallway door. A black key comes from one troll declaration in the Tower of Uncertainty; a blue key comes from one greater demon in the queen's chamber. Check the actual appearance and item.

Zrilxa carries the glowing key for the Tower of Choices, and a nearby portal enters that tower. The plaque claims one choice, but the configured key has a chance to break rather than guaranteed single use. Choosing, unlocking and moving are separate actions with no recorded branch decision.

The mighty throne is a push-triggered switch, but its current target is an already-open hallway exit. It does not implement the described throne opening. The throne-room northern route currently loads as an ordinary open connection; a reviewed native repair must settle the intended access and return behavior.

The tailor in the underground drow city wants cloth carried by the translucent dragon. Its source declaration is in a holding chamber with real connecting exits, not an exitless room. Current appearance, roaming and access still need qualification. Supplied cloth also crafts the first cloak.

The tailor's eight cloak forms share the same visible name and mostly the same keywords, but their native properties differ. Each reworking consumes the current form and produces the next; the eighth returns to the first. These support exchanges give no additional quest or daily achievements.

Torrok accepts only restored Oblivion. The patrolling underground guard's thick steel longsword is the correct raw kind for Thurdorf, while ordinary steel swords with the same lookup aliases are different. Supplied Oblivion works without a restoration receipt. The mask reward does not prove its later use.

Thurdorf also polishes a dull bracelet and helmet. The fisherman exchanges a dirty seashell and original shark tooth earring for different jewelry. These are support recipes; current custody is separate from producer history, and competing consumers do not duplicate spent materials.

Guilds, epic constitution teaching, inn rental, ordinary shops, fishing and ship/crew operations retain their own rules. Nirrel's ambient blizzard and Mimir thoughts, the aging woman's rumors, the graveyard and palace lore do not create automatic taught-skill, learned-keyword or cleared-area achievements.

story_mappings.introduction: Bloodstone connects the lost locket and upper prison, royal-ring reward, four distinct amulet quarters, missionary proof and unfinished Numbaca plot. Independent local commissions sit beside distant artifact and alchemy recipes. Discovery and player progress require active accounting. Topic words explain the story; they are not separate achievements.
orientation: The forest and regional approaches lead through glowing spheres to the drawbridge and keep. These portals use enter; confirmed travel is separate from a turn-in receipt. The drawbridge and keep gate are open routes in the reviewed data.

The golden locket lies inside the pregnant corpse at the forest altar, beyond the concealed northern path. Return it to the ailing mage for the upper-prison key. Supplied lockets or keys can avoid earlier history.

Ordinary prison access uses the prison key sold by local tavern contacts. The upper gates use the mage's blue skeleton key. Grey and blue cell keys are separate. Some black-key doors described as locked actually reset closed but unlocked; do not assume every prose barrier needs a key.

A blue fish supplies the reception key to the Forbidden Tower. The mistress supplies or carries the sapphire key for the upper royal chambers. The baron wears the royal ring and carries the fourth amulet quarter; these fund separate exchanges.

The mother, father and Faust supply three different quarters and leave after their rewards. The baron carries the fourth. The high mage requires all four distinct kinds together, despite their identical displayed names.

The captain transforms the missionary's original head into a different same-named head for his wife. Her other exact ingredients include a bloody scalp with no confirmed ordinary producer. Her pendant reward points toward Pellops, but the follow-on exchange is absent.

The fisherman's lizard request supplies Asmond's flute. The old woman's mistress-proof reward mentions Ferris; Ferris's minotaur lyre supplies a captain clue and experience, rather than an amulet quarter. These clues do not themselves record learned topics.

Sabrina requires both baby item kinds at once. The ordinary bloody head returned by the mother is rejection feedback. Delivery of loaded trophies does not prove personal combat, a rescue, freshness or a faction choice.

The ring ladder in the vegetable garden and the tight-passage portal provide routes to the meditation platform's bones, ear and ordinary head. Get offerings out of containers and remove equipment before a native turn-in.

Moldar, Sark, Navift, Fibblefinger and Hedvig have no confirmed ordinary active placements in the reviewed sources. Their recipe guidance is still useful for supplied or recovered stock and later builder integration; verify that the actual recipient is present.

Winterhaven provides plain equipment, ingots, blueprint routes, hilts, armor flints and the binding-orb exchange. Each artifact needs its exact upgraded base and distant components. Several component sources remain unconfirmed; separate recipes keep separate ownership.

Bloodstone's Storm legplates recipe needs rolling thunder and Gaia's blessing. Winterhaven instead requires ten maelstrom components alongside the base, orb and flint. Equal rewards do not imply equal inputs or a shared completion.

Fibblefinger requires six planar essences and five potion kinds for two elixirs. Winterhaven and Alatorin use different recipes for the same reward. The generic attribute-scroll transformation chooses one random kind; Hedvig needs two matching scrolls for each basic earring.

The nine-earring finale costs 500000 copper and is currently unavailable under active accounting. Maelborg's stat shop also refuses active-accounting purchases. The ordinary inn and Cerrio's separate world-quest service have their own service rules, without local story completion.

Fresh reset supply and committed scripted transformations still need qualification. Supplied items can satisfy delivery; inventory readiness, keys, topic words and reward prose do not establish personal acquisition or every earlier stage.

contacts.description: Starts on the road below the observatory and can roam. Ask hello about specialization; his actual teacher properties support class development. The table-driven Infuse Magical Device purchase remains unavailable while accounting is active.
contacts.name: Deathium

contacts.description: Grudat's black-market shop: exact fortress and security keys, lockpicks, wards and disguise supplies. Ask service for the rename lead; paid renaming is guarded while accounting is active.
contacts.name: Grudat

contacts.description: Construction-lane cliffside workshop: return the second-draft blueprints for the silk cape.
contacts.name: a gnomish engineer

contacts.description: Griffon aviary: the adjoining pet catalog holds a tame griffon. Buying, renting and claiming pets are guarded while accounting is active; aviary lore is not a transport quest.
contacts.name: Anaeus

contacts.description: Moonshade covenant cavern: Zeenium's soul gives a halo; the other three soul donations have no declared rewards. Every offering consumes proof needed by the box.
contacts.name: Selaraim

contacts.description: Cliff-side dwelling: return the recovered study for a distinct delivery copy. Onward delivery belongs to a foreign recipient.
contacts.name: Rigid

contacts.description: Tower of Winds: ask blueprints about the approved second draft and missing runner. This clue grants no keyword achievement.
contacts.name: the construction foreman

contacts.description: Council chambers: carries Zeenium's soul, one of four different proofs required by the box.
contacts.name: Zeenium

contacts.description: Sacred glen: a druid specialization teacher through actual properties. Storm pilgrimage and instruction prose do not add a quest receipt.
contacts.name: Adaruen

contacts.description: Starts in the cliff-side alley and can roam: carries exact slink fur for the camp trapper.
contacts.name: a mountain slink

contacts.description: Immaterial prison reached through the oracle orb: accepts four distinct souls together. This box is an NPC rather than a storage container.
contacts.name: pandora's box

contacts.description: Fortress prison cells: accepts the security key for cash and retires only that smuggler appearance.
contacts.name: an imprisoned smuggler

contacts.description: Starts in a cliff-side dwelling and can roam: ask friend or golem about the distant plans; accepts the actual siege-golem plans.
contacts.name: an elderly engineer

contacts.description: Inner council chamber: carries Strata's exact soul.
contacts.name: Strata

contacts.description: Northern council chamber: carries Omoona's exact soul.
contacts.name: Omoona

contacts.description: Starts in the Star Circle and can roam: accepts raw living wind for its wearable counterpart.

contacts.description: Council chambers: carries Ignor's exact soul.
contacts.name: Ignor

contacts.description: Fortress parapet: carries the council entrance key.
contacts.name: Plume Meteorhand

story_mappings.introduction: Explore Ultarium and its mountain camp: seven independent story outcomes, including recoveries, offerings and a four-soul seal, plus eight optional support-service rows. Active, ready accounting is required.
orientation: Loaded Surface Realm approaches reach the sky-city road and the mountain camp on Darkstone Island. They discover one shared area, while each contact still needs an encounter. The stories have a useful suggested order without a mandatory campaign sequence.

The foreman's blueprint clue leads to papers nested in a wounded-runner container in the mine. Enter the cave at the mountain crevice; its ladder has falling hazards. Remove the papers into top-level carrying and return them to the construction engineer. No living-runner rescue is implemented.

The elderly engineer's separate request uses siege-golem plans nested in a skeleton in the harpy settlement. The local blueprint return is independent and cannot substitute. Supplied exact plans satisfy either native request without a personal recovery history.

The recovered planetary study and its onward delivery copy have identical names but distinct object kinds. The local scholar records the first exchange; Xavier in Myrabolus owns the later delivery receipt. Possessing either output alone records neither quest.

Fortress progression uses three exact keys: Grudat's sunstone key opens the outer gates, an antechamber carrier has the oblong stair key, and a parapet carrier has the council key. The smuggler needs a separate security key. Current key checks are optional guidance, not proof of historical access.

The four council members carry four different souls. The director pays a halo only for Zeenium's soul; his other three independent offerings consume their soul without declared rewards. Any donation competes with the box's simultaneous four-soul collection and does not establish permanent council defeat.

Touch the oracle orb to reach the immaterial prison and its NPC box; north returns to the oracle. The box has a 50-percent reset declaration. Acceptance of all four distinct souls grants bracers, robes, gloves and an Ultarium memory. Reward use and world liberation need separate accepted events.

The raw and wearable wisps of living wind share a name. Raw proof comes from a covenant windkin with a 33-percent reset declaration. The windwalker accepts it for the wearable counterpart. Neither possession nor the companion-loss text proves a personally recorded kill.

The dwarven camp offers six independent trapper barters and a hydra-scale gorget service. Foreign trophies have exact sources, caps and possible holding/dispersal routes. The trapper's emblem is a reward for the heart, without an enforced trust prerequisite for other trades.

Two pushable boulders open opposite sides of a secret blocked cliff passage. The warp platform uses stomp to return to the city entrance. These actions, the magical fountain, epic stone, class teachers and griffon services have their own mechanics and no new journal milestones without accepted evidence.

Paid rename, pet purchase/rental/claim and epic skill purchases remain guarded while accounting is active. Native item offerings remain available subject to supported settlement. Exact gifts are valid for delivery without manufacturing personal acquisition, learned topics, travel, faction or full-stage completion.

story_mappings.introduction: Jade connects rice-field work, wild creatures, family proofs, royal audience and a rescue at sea. Discover the Empire and meet its people to reveal their journal requests. Deliveries record their exact outcomes; personal sources, battles, access and escort need their own evidence. Active, ready accounting is required.
orientation: Start with the city streets, eight rice paddies, tool shed and long pier. Five current rice portions make a harvest bag; the wheel below the wheelhouse turns that bag into ground rice. Supplied exact ingredients work without that preparation history.

Choose how to use each ground-rice portion: the kite-flyer makes a hat, the chef makes sushi, and the bartender makes a drink. The mystic can enchant the hat or a simple necktie for 10,000 copper each; those paid enchantments still need accounting support.

The hunter wants four exact boar-meat strips together. Giving the giant boar hide instead is an upsetting rejection that removes him. The word fresh in an item name does not add a freshness clock or require your own kill.

Enter the tool shed to recover the knife from its shelves. Give it to the entangled coastline turtle to receive a carried turtle. That turtle can pay the chef's soup or the tamer's two-silver-ore exchange; one copy cannot pay both.

The gardener combines one emerald-rose seed portion, two orchid-seed portions, one bonzai seed and one lilac-seed portion. Search the appropriate plants and remove their seeds from the containers. Rose seeds are outside the royal audience door; an audience key is not required for that source. Snapdragon seeds and cherry blossoms are not accepted.

The tamer sells giant nets for 10,000 copper; that purchase still needs accounting support. Give an available net to the alpha razorback or dark outlaw for the corresponding captured item, then deliver that item to its reward recipient. Captures become carried items rather than following creatures, and nets dissolve when dropped.

For the hidden cave, push the stone switch at its secret approach. Scralack carries the blood-red key and the cave bin contains the signet ring. His key opens the assassin guild but breaks on use; the separate Winterhaven entry reaches the guild attic. The soldier of fortune rewards the ring and departs, without a declared army-return finale.

The shifty orc's dice-shaped key fits the secret Tigerlily doorway to Feng Cho and the outlaw. A hydra heart plus Feng Cho's finger earns the Daimyo's invitation. His heart-only briefing returns a new heart and is optional. The bushi exchanges the invitation for the emerald royal key; use that key for the Emperor's room.

The high priest wants four distinct directional relics. The eastern relic is carried by Agaures' physical projection beyond the cave mirror; the western relic is inside an obsidian-keyed obelisk in the Rogue invasion. The northern eye and southern Nansuo use foreign load rooms and movement. Supplied exact relics qualify without those journeys.

The sobbing woman wants the heirloom inside the hive mother's bones. Kobe Chi's mark goes to the chamberlain; Kyan Itsu's medallion goes to the Bloodstone delegate. Each proof is an independent delivery, and legends or load positions do not guarantee personal combat or availability.

Ask Macavor about mande and troggahn. Mande's head comes from the Oda barracks; Troggahn's egg is carried by the black dragon below Father Tel's Holy Cloister. Bring both together. Mande's robes and other egg requests remain separate foreign paths.

The metalsmith combines attic electrum and wyrm-carried adamantium into electium. Weapon and armor commissions each consume a separate bar, the matching template and 10,000 copper. The weapon template is in the tool-shed shelves; the armor template is inside harbor cargo crates. Paid commissions, the separate forge menu and mining still need accounting support.

The royal rescue continues in the neighboring ship-battle area. Marn carries the brig key in the den beneath the pier, reached by pushing the pillars. Miu Pai carries a different set of keys on the Lacedon helm. The keyless locked helm trapdoor has an alternative underwater route through the secret cargo porthole; the brig key opens the princess's cell.

Give Miu Pai's set of keys to the captive princess for her royal token, then bring the token to the Emperor. A supplied token skips the rescue preparation. The token delivery does not prove the brig unlock, your own fighting or an escort back to the palace. The ambassador separately accepts the purse from the huge olyx in the neighboring fields.

The lost legionaire accepts a Jade map. The neighboring halfling's purchase costs 50,000 copper and still needs accounting support, while the legionaire pays 10,000 copper and experience. The mystic's white silk belt exchange has no declared outcome and earns no journal credit.

Fresh supplies depend on available stock, appearance chances and recipients. Carry exact current offerings outside equipment and containers. Supporting cooking, crafting, capture and access exchanges stay visible without adding separate quest achievements or dailies; journal reads and readiness checks award nothing.
