story_mappings.introduction: The Twin Keeps connect four realms and several independent commissions. Follow Kristigrogg's key route, the ore and crystal recipes, the scouting-message chain, or the Refuge and pirate requests. Each exchange keeps its own reward and history. Discovery and progress require active accounting; source availability and scripted stages still need qualification.
orientation: From ruined Tharnadia, the locked western keep gate uses the city's gate key. The expeditionary leader and an Old Quarter contact offer it for the necromancer's remains; the leader's pouch is another source. The key breaks on use. Rifts and regional approaches can offer other arrival routes.

Kristigrogg trades five claws for the tower key and four distinct same-named life shards for the dungeon key. Tower keys can break while opening the four locked tower approaches; you may need replacements.

The four tower rifts lead to Blackrock Mountain, the Alteran Valley, Blackbeard's island and the Shaeradin Valley. The dungeon's fifth portal leads to the foreign Pit of Dragons. A shown route does not record confirmed travel or a dragon victory.
In Blackrock Mountain, Captain Fizz Thunderfist carries the consumed key to Bostas's High Seat. Bostas carries a life shard and scepter; use separate scepters for separate consumers.

In the Alteran Valley, look for FrostSharn Camp and the two harpy mountains. The warlord contracts accept four distinct hearts, despite head wording. The scouting report is inside the frozen orc corpse on Mount Straka.
Skinjar's report reward leads to Woten's note exchange, CrowFoot's bottled-message delivery and Woten's nether crystal. Supplied intermediate items can skip the producer route.
Jenzuel's recovered bow supplies Hindis's figurine. Deliver the figurine before Hindis's head reward when using the same encounter, because the head exchange removes him.
Trekash's orb leads to Keshia's pirate key. The hidden crevice in the island jungle leads to the locked pirate chest and ether crystal. The key is consumed on unlocking.

In Pirate Cove, pull the massive tied-up crate to open the northward route to the burial cave and captain's key. That consumed key opens the concealed submerged doorway to Blackbeard's remains, chest and life shard.

CrowFoot stays after his egg bounty but leaves after the message delivery. Several other givers also leave after a reward. This area uses epic-triggered rather than ordinary timed resets; do not assume daily replacement.

Thelinnius needs void, earth, nether and ether crystals plus the shadow staff. A concentrated void elemental is another void-crystal source. Earlier exchange history does not replace a spent component.

Ground, carried, equipped and nested sources are distinct. Get offerings out of containers and remove equipment before a native turn-in. Supplied items are accepted; inventory readiness does not establish personal recovery or kills.

Mungir's silverleaf-and-50000-copper payment is currently unavailable under active accounting. Ordinary reset supply also needs qualification. Existing recovered materials and valid receipts can still explain the routes.
Read contacts for useful topic words. Topics, switches, keys, scenery and departures are guidance until their accepted events and outcomes are integrated; each keyword is not an achievement.

steps.hint: The expeditionary leader or the wandering Old Quarter contact accepts the skeletal necromancer's remains for the gate key. Their exchanges belong to ruined Tharnadia. A supplied key or another arrival route can avoid this preparation; the key breaks when used.
steps.text: Optional: earn the outer gate key in ruined Tharnadia

steps.hint: Gremlins carry claws throughout both keeps. Bring five top-level carried claws; supplied copies qualify. This proof records the exchange, rather than personal kills.
steps.text: Carry 5 x a gremlin claw

steps.hint: Reward: a tower key. The giver remains available after the exchange.
steps.text: Bring five gremlin claws to Kristigrogg

stories.summary: Kristigrogg offers the tower key for five gremlin claws. It opens the four tower routes to Blackrock Mountain, the Alteran Valley, Blackbeard's island and the Shaeradin Valley. The key can break on unlocking; another claw exchange can supply a replacement. Supplied claws qualify.
stories.title: Gremlin Claws for the Tower Key

steps.hint: This is one route to the four realms. A supplied key or supplied shards may avoid it. The key can break while unlocking; the receipt does not prove every tower was entered.
steps.text: Optional: earn a tower key from Kristigrogg

steps.hint: Recover this life shard inside Blackbeard's skeletal remains in his sunken quarters. Use the captain's key route from the crate and burial cave. It is distinct from the other three same-named shards.
steps.text: Carry Blackbeard's life shard

steps.hint: Hagluf Crownsplitter carries this life shard in the leader hut of FrostSharn Camp. Bring this exact kind alongside the other three kinds; supplied shards qualify.
steps.text: Carry Hagluf's life shard

steps.hint: Thel'Samar Deathweave carries this life shard atop Dagger Peak, with his head and the shadow staff. This shard is distinct from the Bostas, Hagluf and Blackbeard kinds.
steps.text: Carry Thel'Samar's life shard

steps.hint: Bostas Firebraid carries this life shard at the High Seat of Strak'Ash. Captain Fizz Thunderfist carries the key to the locked approach; that key breaks when used. Supplied shards qualify.
steps.text: Carry Bostas's life shard

steps.hint: Reward: the dungeon key. The giver remains available after the exchange.
steps.text: Bring all four distinct life shards to Kristigrogg

stories.summary: Bring Kristigrogg the four distinct life shards from Bostas, Hagluf, Thel'Samar and Blackbeard's remains. All share a name, but four copies of one kind will not do. He awards the dungeon key and asks you to face Krizzix. This exchange records the key reward; the later dragon journey has no separate quest receipt.
stories.title: Four Distinct Life Shards

steps.hint: Dragon elemental-kin carry hearts of fire in Blackrock Mountain. Bring five hearts together. They are loaded stock, without a custom personal-kill or fresh-birth requirement.
steps.text: Carry 5 x a heart of fire

steps.hint: Reward: a blackrock ring of the dark iron dwarves. The giver leaves afterward.
steps.text: Bring five hearts of fire to Treskin

stories.summary: Treskin needs five hearts of fire for his blackrock ring. Trekash can explain the ingredient; dragon elemental-kin carry it around Blackrock Mountain. Treskin leaves after the exchange. A supplied set records delivery without claiming five personal kills.
stories.title: Treskin's Five Fire Hearts

steps.hint: Dragonlings carry wings in Blackrock Mountain, with additional sources in Alatorin and the Surface Keeps. Trekash needs four. Alatorin has separate consumers, including mixed-payment recipes; one consumed wing cannot fund multiple rewards.
steps.text: Carry 4 x a dragonling wing

steps.hint: Reward: some blue dragonscale shoulder guards. The giver remains available after the exchange.
steps.text: Bring four dragonling wings to Trekash

stories.summary: Bring Trekash four dragonling wings for blue dragonscale shoulder guards. These are separate from his FrostSharn scimitar commission. Dragonlings also appear abroad, and Alatorin has its own wing consumers and a paid recipe for the same guards. That foreign recipe has separate ownership and requirements.
stories.title: Trekash's Dragonling Guards

steps.hint: FrostSharn grunts carry these exact scimitars in the camp. Bring five for the greenstone orb; another scimitar does not substitute.
steps.text: Carry 5 x a FrostSharn scimitar

steps.hint: Reward: a green orb of mystics, 85000 experience. The giver remains available after the exchange.
steps.text: Bring five FrostSharn scimitars to Trekash

stories.summary: Bring Trekash five FrostSharn scimitars for a greenstone orb and 85000 experience. Keshia accepts the orb for an old pirate key; that later exchange is independent. Trekash remains available. Other scimitars do not substitute for the exact FrostSharn kind.
stories.title: Trekash's FrostSharn Orb

steps.hint: Kyzastaxkasis has a chance load in its ancient Azharul dragon cave above Blackrock Mountain, reached through a concealed pass. The scales have a separate chance load. Check current availability rather than assuming the dragon always holds them.
steps.text: Carry 1 x the scales of Kyzastaxkasis

steps.hint: Reward: the spiked platemail of the Azharul dragons. The giver remains available after the exchange.
steps.text: Bring Kyzastaxkasis scales to Thelranak

stories.summary: Thelranak offers Azharul plate for Kyzastaxkasis's scales. The ancient dragon and its scales have separate chance loads, so the source may be absent even when you reach the lair. The blacksmith stays. A supplied scale is valid proof for this commission.
stories.title: Thelranak's Azharul Plate

steps.hint: The blackrock sample lies at the heart of the mining dig site in Blackrock Mountain. Marny accepts the exact ore sample, then supplies an earcuff and a physical receipt.
steps.text: Carry 1 x a chunk of blackrock ore

steps.hint: Reward: a tiny endurium earring, a receipt from Marny Taskgulch. The giver remains available after the exchange.
steps.text: Bring the blackrock sample to Marny

stories.summary: Marny awards an ornate earcuff and a physical receipt for a blackrock sample. His later endurium commission requires that actual receipt, alongside the ore. Recorded history alone cannot replace a receipt that has been spent or lost. Marny stays after either exchange.
stories.title: Marny's Blackrock Sample

steps.hint: His earlier blackrock exchange awards the receipt. A supplied receipt is accepted, and recorded history cannot replace the physical item.
steps.text: Optional: obtain the physical receipt from Marny

steps.hint: Marny supplies this physical receipt with his blackrock reward. His endurium exchange consumes the actual item. Recorded completion is optional history and does not replace a spent receipt; a supplied receipt is accepted.
steps.text: Carry 1 x a receipt from Marny Taskgulch

steps.hint: The endurium ore lies in a small cave at the end of the eastern Pirate Cove tunnel. Bring it with Marny's physical receipt. This differs from the nether ore exchanged by CrowFoot and Woten.
steps.text: Carry 1 x some endurium ore

steps.hint: Reward: a segmented endurium belt, a void crystal. The giver remains available after the exchange.
steps.text: Bring endurium ore and the physical receipt to Marny

stories.summary: Bring Marny endurium ore and his physical receipt together for a blackrock belt and void crystal. The earlier blackrock exchange is one preparation route; supplied ore and receipt are accepted. A concentrated void elemental is an alternative source of the crystal, without this commission's history.
stories.title: Marny's Endurium Commission

steps.hint: The hunting hat lies in the Frozen Claw Hall of FrostSharn Camp. It belongs to Zaden's independent return request, alongside the other camp stories.
steps.text: Carry 1 x a hunting hat

steps.hint: Reward: a marksman's quiver. The giver leaves afterward.
steps.text: Return the hunting hat to Zaden

stories.summary: Return Zaden's hunting hat from the Frozen Claw Hall for a marksman's quiver. He leaves after thanking you. His departure prose does not record a player teleport or a scouting achievement. A supplied hat is accepted.
stories.title: Zaden's Lost Hunting Hat

steps.hint: Thresh Blackmane carries his distinct bloody heart in the Alteran Valley. Kralth accepts this heart despite asking for heads. Alatorin's Kirrb and Doklin also consume full heart sets.
steps.text: Carry 1 x the bloody heart of Thresh Blackmane

steps.hint: Grimmar Stonebrow carries this distinct bloody heart in the Alteran Valley. One heart of another warlord cannot substitute; keep separate sets for competing consumers.
steps.text: Carry 1 x the bloody heart of Grimmar Stonebrow

steps.hint: Axelon Clawgrip carries this distinct bloody heart in the Alteran Valley. Bring it with the other three hearts; a supplied heart qualifies.
steps.text: Carry 1 x the bloody heart of Axelon Clawgrip

steps.hint: Riker Firstfang carries this distinct bloody heart in the Alteran Valley. The name differs from the Frostfang wording in dialogue. Bring all four distinct hearts together.
steps.text: Carry 1 x the bloody heart of Riker Firstfang

steps.hint: Reward: a tribal warlord mask, 200000 copper. The giver leaves afterward.
steps.text: Bring the four distinct warlord hearts to Kralth

stories.summary: Kralth's dialogue asks for heads, but his contract accepts four distinct bloody hearts: Thresh Blackmane, Grimmar Stonebrow, Axelon Clawgrip and Riker Firstfang. Bring all four for a tribal mask and 200000 copper. He leaves afterward. Alatorin's assassins consume separate sets for their own rewards.
stories.title: Kralth's Four Warlord Hearts

steps.hint: Bren'Shan harpies carry feathers on Mount Bren'Shan. Bring three of this tribe and three Straka feathers; six of one kind do not qualify.
steps.text: Carry 3 x a Bren'Shan harpy feather

steps.hint: Straka harpies carry feathers on Mount Straka. Bring three of this tribe and three Bren'Shan feathers. Delivered trophies do not record territorial conquest.
steps.text: Carry 3 x a Straka harpy feather

steps.hint: Reward: a necklace of frost harpy feathers, 450000 experience. The giver remains available after the exchange.
steps.text: Bring three feathers from each harpy tribe to Skinjar

stories.summary: Bring Skinjar three Bren'Shan harpy feathers and three Straka harpy feathers together for a frost-harpy necklace and 450000 experience. Six feathers of one tribe do not qualify. The delivered trophies do not establish territory conquest or a completed campaign.
stories.title: Skinjar's Two Harpy Tribes

steps.hint: The report lies inside the frozen orc corpse in a snowy gorge on Mount Straka. Get the report out of the corpse; scenery or another dead animal does not substitute. A supplied report is accepted.
steps.text: Carry 1 x a scouting report

steps.hint: Reward: a carefully packaged note. The giver remains available after the exchange.
steps.text: Bring the scouting report to Skinjar

stories.summary: Recover the scouting report inside the frozen orc corpse in the Mount Straka gorge and deliver it to Skinjar. He supplies a packaged note for Woten. The later note, bottle-message and nether-ore exchanges each have their own receipts. A supplied report is accepted.
stories.title: The Recovered Scouting Report

steps.hint: The exact silverleaf has ground sources in the Tharnadia Rifts patch of silverleaf trees and two Elemental Plane groves. Bring it with the 50000-copper fee. Active accounting currently refuses this mixed offering.
steps.text: Carry 1 x a silverleaf

steps.hint: This exact item-and-coin offering is currently unavailable under active accounting. Qualify atomic payment, input retirement and potion publication before enabling it. The potion does not record a named cure.
steps.text: Bring the silverleaf and 50000 copper to Mungir

stories.summary: Mungir asks for the exact silverleaf and 50000 copper for a curing potion. Known silverleaf sources are the Tharnadia Rifts grove and the Elemental Plane groves. This mixed payment is currently unavailable under active accounting. The potion service does not establish a named patient cure or achievement.
stories.title: Mungir's Silverleaf Remedy

steps.hint: The longbow lies in the concealed alcove off Dagger Peak's upper ramp. Return it to Jenzuel, who supplies the mystical figurine for Hindis's separate exchange.
steps.text: Carry 1 x the MoonGaze longbow

steps.hint: Reward: a small orog figurine, 350000 copper, 600000 experience. The giver leaves afterward.
steps.text: Return the longbow to Jenzuel

stories.summary: Return Jenzuel's longbow from the secret alcove in Dagger Peak for his mystical figurine, 350000 copper and 600000 experience. Hindis accepts the figurine for night-elven boots. Jenzuel leaves; Hindis's separate head reward also removes that later recipient, so consider your delivery order.
stories.title: Jenzuel's Missing Longbow

steps.hint: This records the producer exchange. A supplied figurine is also valid, and Hindis's head reward may remove him before this delivery.
steps.text: Optional: recover Jenzuel's bow for the figurine

steps.hint: Jenzuel's longbow reward supplies this figurine. Hindis accepts it for boots and stays, but his separate head reward removes him. A supplied figurine qualifies without Jenzuel's receipt.
steps.text: Carry 1 x a small orog figurine

steps.hint: Reward: some high boots of the night elves. The giver remains available after the exchange.
steps.text: Bring the mystical figurine to Hindis

stories.summary: Deliver the mystical figurine to Hindis for boots of the Night Elven Hunt. Jenzuel's bow reward is an optional preparation route when you already have the figurine. Hindis stays after this exchange, but leaves after his independent Thel'Samar-head reward. Check his availability before planning both.
stories.title: Hindis's Figurine Exchange

steps.hint: Thel'Samar carries his head atop Dagger Peak. Hindis leaves after this reward; consider delivering the figurine first if you want both. The head differs from the separately useful shadow staff and life shard.
steps.text: Carry 1 x the bloody head of Thel'Samar Deathweave

steps.hint: Reward: a finely woven crystal bracelet. The giver leaves afterward.
steps.text: Bring Thel'Samar's head to Hindis

stories.summary: Bring Hindis the head of Thel'Samar for a crystal bracelet. He leaves after this reward, making his figurine exchange unavailable for that encounter. Thel'Samar also carries the shadow staff and a life shard, used by independent Twin Keeps stories. Delivering a supplied head is valid.
stories.title: Hindis's Thel'Samar Proof

steps.hint: His five-scimitar commission supplies the orb. You may deliver a supplied orb without that earlier receipt.
steps.text: Optional: obtain the greenstone orb from Trekash

steps.hint: Trekash awards this greenstone orb for five FrostSharn scimitars. Keshia exchanges the actual orb for the pirate-chest key; an earlier receipt cannot replace a spent orb.
steps.text: Carry 1 x a green orb of mystics

steps.hint: Reward: an old pirate's key. The giver remains available after the exchange.
steps.text: Bring the greenstone orb to Keshia

stories.summary: Bring Keshia the greenstone orb for an old pirate key. Trekash's scimitar commission can supply the orb, or you may use a supplied one. Her jungle clue leads to a hidden cave containing the locked pirate chest and ether crystal. The key is consumed when used; the reward receipt does not prove that you opened the chest.
stories.title: Keshia's Pirate Key

steps.hint: Giant and hungry ravasaurs carry these teeth in the Shaeradin Valley. Bring six exact teeth to Venali. Supplied teeth qualify without recording personal kills.
steps.text: Carry 6 x a sharp ravasaur tooth

steps.hint: Reward: a ravasaur tooth necklace, 500000 experience. The giver leaves afterward.
steps.text: Bring six ravasaur teeth to Venali

stories.summary: Bring Venali six ravasaur teeth for the Amulet of the Earth and 500000 experience. The giant and hungry ravasaurs carry these teeth in the Shaeradin Valley. Venali leaves afterward. A delivered set does not prove six personal kills.
stories.title: Venali's Six Ravasaur Teeth

steps.hint: Marny's endurium commission is one source; a concentrated void elemental or supplied crystal is another. The final staff still needs the actual crystal.
steps.text: Optional: earn Marny's void crystal

steps.hint: His moonstone exchange supplies one crystal and removes him. A supplied crystal is accepted.
steps.text: Optional: earn Weskel's earth crystal

steps.hint: His ore exchange supplies one crystal. A supplied crystal is accepted.
steps.text: Optional: earn Woten's nether crystal

steps.hint: The key helps recover the ether crystal. This receipt does not record opening or recovering the chest contents; a supplied crystal avoids that route.
steps.text: Optional: obtain Keshia's pirate-chest key

steps.hint: Marny supplies one void crystal with the endurium reward. A concentrated void elemental in the collapsed Caer Dauthe corridor is another chance-loaded source. Either source or a supplied crystal is accepted; the other elemental types do not all carry it.
steps.text: Carry 1 x a void crystal

steps.hint: Thel'Samar carries the staff of the Shadow Mage atop Dagger Peak. Thelinnius requires this staff alongside four crystals; another staff or a fifth crystal will not substitute.
steps.text: Carry 1 x a shadow staff

steps.hint: Weskel exchanges a rare moonstone for one earth crystal, then leaves. Naboriyan can supply the moonstone, or you may use supplied components. The actual crystal is needed for the final staff.
steps.text: Carry 1 x an earth crystal

steps.hint: Woten exchanges nether ore for one nether crystal. CrowFoot can supply the ore for Woten's bottled message. Supplied ore or a supplied crystal also qualify; history does not replace a spent ingredient.
steps.text: Carry 1 x a nether crystal

steps.hint: The ether crystal lies inside the locked pirate chest in the secret jungle cave, reached through the hidden crevice. Keshia supplies its old pirate key for the greenstone orb. Get the actual crystal out of the chest; a supplied crystal is accepted.
steps.text: Carry 1 x an ether crystal

steps.hint: Reward: the staff of twin worlds. The giver remains available after the exchange. Only this final delivery completes this staff entry. Earlier source exchanges remain distinct; the finale does not prove every route or personal acquisition.
steps.text: Bring four distinct crystals and the shadow staff to Thelinnius

stories.summary: Bring Thelinnius four different crystals—void, earth, nether and ether—and the staff of the Shadow Mage together. The shadow staff is the fifth required item, rather than a fifth crystal. Ore exchanges, moonstone and pirate-message deliveries are optional source routes; supplied components are accepted. The final reward is the staff of Twin Worlds.
stories.title: The Staff of Twin Worlds

steps.hint: Bostas holds this scepter at Strak'Ash's High Seat. Captain Fizz Thunderfist carries the approach key, which breaks on use. Naboriyan and two Alatorin weapon collectors consume separate copies for separate rewards.
steps.text: Carry 1 x the scepter of Bostas Firebraid

steps.hint: Reward: 500000 copper, a moonstone. The giver leaves afterward.
steps.text: Bring Bostas Firebraid's scepter to Naboriyan

stories.summary: Bring Naboriyan Bostas Firebraid's scepter for a rare moonstone and 500000 copper. Weskel accepts that moonstone for an earth crystal in a separate exchange. Naboriyan leaves. Alatorin's weapon collectors also consume the scepter with four other weapons; reserve separate copies for separate rewards.
stories.title: Naboriyan's Moonstone Reward

steps.hint: Recover the report or bring a supplied one. Woten also accepts a supplied note directly.
steps.text: Optional: obtain Skinjar's packaged note

steps.hint: Skinjar supplies the packaged note for the recovered scouting report. Deliver the actual note to Woten in Dagger Peak; a supplied note is accepted.
steps.text: Carry 1 x a carefully packaged note

steps.hint: Reward: a message in a bottle. The giver remains available after the exchange.
steps.text: Bring the packaged note to Woten

stories.summary: Bring Woten Skinjar's packaged note. Woten supplies a bottled message for CrowFoot McGuillies, who offers nether ore in return. Woten remains available for the eventual ore-to-crystal exchange. Supplied notes qualify; his ambient actions do not provide extra learned-topic achievements.
stories.title: Woten's Bottled Message

steps.hint: This begins one ore-source route; supplied ore avoids it.
steps.text: Optional: deliver the scouting report to Skinjar

steps.hint: Deliver Skinjar's note to receive the bottle. Supplied ore avoids this earlier exchange.
steps.text: Optional: obtain Woten's bottled message

steps.hint: The message exchange supplies ore and removes CrowFoot. Supplied ore is also accepted by Woten.
steps.text: Optional: obtain nether ore from CrowFoot

steps.hint: CrowFoot awards nether ore for Woten's bottled message, then leaves. Bring the ore back to Woten for one crystal. This differs from Marny's endurium ore.
steps.text: Carry 1 x some nether ore

steps.hint: Reward: a nether crystal. The giver remains available after the exchange.
steps.text: Bring the nether ore to Woten

stories.summary: Bring Woten nether ore for one nether crystal. The scouting-report, note and bottled-message route can supply the ore, or you may bring a supplied copy. His reward text describes several crystals, but the contract awards one. The crystal is one component of Thelinnius's final staff.
stories.title: Woten's Nether Crystal

steps.hint: Lord Zorana wears his signet ring at the top of the Refuge tower. Gul'Thak accepts the exact ring, including a supplied copy. This delivery does not select a faction or record a personal kill.
steps.text: Carry 1 x a golden signet of Zorana Felwood

steps.hint: Reward: a shadowmage band, 1750000 copper. The giver leaves afterward.
steps.text: Bring Zorana's signet ring to Gul'Thak

stories.summary: Bring Gul'Thak Lord Zorana's signet ring for the Band of the Shadow Mage and 1750000 copper. Gul'Thak leaves afterward. This opposing-faction request is independent of the Refuge's other exchanges; it does not record allegiance, personal defeat of Zorana or a completed war.
stories.title: Gul'Thak's Zorana Signet

steps.hint: His scepter exchange supplies the moonstone. A supplied moonstone is valid without this receipt.
steps.text: Optional: obtain Naboriyan's moonstone

steps.hint: Naboriyan awards the rare moonstone for Bostas's scepter. Weskel consumes the actual moonstone for an earth crystal, then leaves. A supplied moonstone is accepted.
steps.text: Carry 1 x a moonstone

steps.hint: Reward: an earth crystal. The giver leaves afterward.
steps.text: Bring the rare moonstone to Weskel

stories.summary: Bring Weskel the rare moonstone for one earth crystal. Naboriyan's scepter reward is an optional producer route; a supplied moonstone is accepted. Weskel leaves after the exchange. His description of several crystals does not change the one-item reward used by Thelinnius.
stories.title: Weskel's Earth Crystal

steps.hint: Blackbeard's chest lies inside his skeletal remains in the captain's sunken quarters. Pull the massive crate in Veedle's cave, recover the key from the burial cave, then unlock the submerged doorway. Give Mithranil the chest itself, after checking any contents; opening its own lock is not a prerequisite.
steps.text: Carry 1 x Blackbeard's chest

steps.hint: Reward: a pair of mailed dragoon gloves. The giver leaves afterward.
steps.text: Bring Blackbeard's chest itself to Mithranil

stories.summary: Retrieve Blackbeard's chest from his sunken skeletal remains and bring the chest itself to Mithranil for mailed gloves. A pullable crate opens a route to the key for the captain's quarters. Mithranil leaves after rewarding you. Offering a container retires its contents too; inspect any contents before handing it over.

steps.text: Carry 5 x a red pirate's bandana

steps.hint: Woten supplies it for Skinjar's note. A supplied bottle is accepted without this history.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a basilisk egg

story_mappings.introduction: The chrysloin grow and shape living crystals, but their king fears the imprisoned mage who created them. The rainbow-key route is the local progression story. Colored-crystal shaping, moss preparation and the sage's paid clue are separate services; returned wrong-color offerings are feedback.
orientation: The entrance golem blocks ordinary north passage for levels 21 through 50. Inside, the crystal groves and moss clearings provide exact ground materials. Look for loose stock; descriptions of gems welded to stone do not implement an extra mining or harvest quest.

Match each crystal to its maker: violet for a collar, blue for a shield, green for a javelin and red for an earring. The local chrysloin shaman makes a mossy potion. These services remain separate from the king's story.

A concealed stone path reaches the spire gates. The burly guards' glowing crystal shard unlocks the entrance. Follow the crystal hallways to the throne room and ask the king about his kind, worries and the drow mage. Questions provide guidance, not achievements for every keyword.

A gap below the white crystal farm leads into wet lower caverns. Beyond the brackish-water pool, the hot crystal is a hazardous remote switch: push it to unblock a west passage elsewhere in the lower cavern. The switch itself does not move you or complete a quest.

The lower guardian carries the rainbow crystal key. Its intended death pile is a container, different from old blue remains and wearable shard piles. Recover the exact key, or use a supplied copy; the intact key is not accepted by the king as a finale.

The hidden ceiling trapdoor in the spire leads to the mage's quarters, then a concealed wall reaches his library. His normal ward blocks attacks and casting. Giving him the rainbow key creates exact rainbow shards on the floor and removes him. This custom exchange still needs reliable accounting and failure recovery; the king can accept supplied shards directly.

The sage's 2,000-copper paid clue is optional and currently unavailable under active accounting. Her topic guidance remains useful. The amber and hidden vaults have their own keys and treasures; they are optional exploration rather than king-story prerequisites.

Bring the exact rainbow shards to the king for his mask. Carry offerings directly, outside containers or equipment. Current supplies show readiness; the successful recorded delivery completes the story while accounting is active. It does not prove a personal kill, learned clue or the entire narrated route.

This custom source and the mage's key exchange still need qualification; the key alone cannot complete the king's delivery.

Supplied rainbow shards qualify.

The king's recorded delivery does not prove a personal guardian victory, mage kill, learned secret or every earlier journey.
stories.title: The Rainbow Key and the King

story_mappings.introduction: Explore Alatorin's kitchens, workshops, guilds, royal requests, outposts, port and First Mountain shrines. Exact deliveries have independent outcomes; preparation and source history are optional. Active, ready accounting is required. Some paid, mining and material routes await supported settlement.
orientation: Meet the Stonebrew, BrightAxe, Hammerhelm and guild cooks. Each royal dish independently earns a culinary token from the King's attendant; ten current tokens pay Modan. Serving one dish does not complete all four courses.

The outer-city spice merchant supplies mandrake, garlic and green herb; the fruit vendor stocks apples, oranges and bananas; the elven peddler stocks dust, dragon blood and stones; the potion vendor stocks empty bottles. Purchase availability needs accounting-qualified stock.

Dweef trades 209 ordinary salvaged kinds for one fragment each. Ten fragments make one collecting token. Nebula adds copper; vellum gives three fragments; the strange object gives a full token and treasure. Ten tinkerer tokens give only one fragment, and have no ordinary reviewed source.

Ten exact collecting, dragonslaying, mining, cooking, stealth or siege tokens pay Modan for a medal and family-specific gifts. Ten medals earn the honor key; four medals instead buy gnome currency from Dweef. A single token receipt does not establish ten current tokens.

Miboli needs blank paper and two identical components for each arcanum. One of each of ten arcanums makes an enchantment scroll and gnome token. Winterhaven's Lancer supplies all five elemental components for one gem-studded dragon hide; that foreign receipt is optional.

Reciting an enchantment scroll draws one random attribute scroll. Electrum plus two matching scrolls make the corresponding ring. All nine distinct rings plus 500,000 copper make wondrous power. Eighteen random draws do not guarantee a complete matching set; supplied materials remain valid.

Mining, smelting, salvage, refining and paid native offerings currently refuse active accounting. Their journals explain exact supplied-input alternatives. Readiness shows item quantities; it does not guarantee payment support, fresh source issuance or personal preparation.

Gimbrin uses six identical materials plus matching armor and a fee; Xamora uses eight identical materials, two tokens and a fee. Steel/cold iron and wood/leather alternatives are whole recipes. Mixed material batches do not qualify. Mundorno's two overlapping blue-tunic recipes remain separate.

The mystic gardener requests all four distinct flowers together. Mishanen carries all four on separate rare stock rolls; the rose also has ground stock in the Fortress of Dreams. Twin Towers' gardener belt does not gate this local recipe. All three library books yield deadly mist; the Baron separately consumes Jedd's book.

Royal and rival proofs have competing uses: Noroth's head pays Taark, Queen Bellethra or Mundorno; the wedding band pays Taark or the attendant; Kereghaktis's head pays Sturb or Uttan. Guild recipients with equal terms still own separate requests. One current proof cannot pay multiple consumers.

The four northern hearts are declared on carriers in the Alteran Valley dispersal room, despite Frost Sharn wording. Mixt and Lyena have separate Twin Towers carriers. The five dwarven weapons have distinct foreign equipped sources; delivered proofs do not prove your kills or allegiance.

Jenk needs both royal signets for his stealth reward and then leaves. His five potion recipes, all-five elixir recipe and elixir-plus-token upgrade are supporting services. Prepare first or find another available appearance; supplied higher outputs can skip personal preparation.

Deramuth requests include both beast hearts for Ravi, a current mountaineer insignia for Locke, five different brewery casks for Naltem, and two distinct crate buybacks. Egg-to-soup routes compete with egg buyers and food buybacks. Osquip remains can expire before cooking.

The armoire and hidden button use push; the shrine statues use hit; vine travel uses grab. Keys unlock specific doors or containers and can break. An open wall, an unlocked door and confirmed travel are different effects. The malformed abandoned-tower switch and royal blocked gate need builder decisions.

The First Mountain shard passes through independent divine exchanges as replacement copies. Seven gifts do not establish a full pilgrimage; two priests only return it without added gifts. Vergadain's coins and Abbathor's satchel are money-item rewards whose accounting handling needs qualification.

Ask the named contacts about their listed topics for explanations. Dialogue is informational, without a learned-topic achievement. Current supplies and optional earlier receipts help explain preparation; only an accepted final exchange completes its own request. Rare recipients, caps, gifts and recovered stock affect availability.

story_mappings.introduction: The Realm of Barovia follows the village's distress through lost Lightbringers, a forged family letter, a cottage ambush, nine scattered trinkets, Doru's heart and Mad Mary's missing daughter. Native deliveries record their exact outcomes; narrated liberation, learned lore and personal kills need separate evidence. Player progress requires active, ready accounting.
orientation: The Road of the Dead in Bloodstone connects to the southern Svalich Woods road. The Weary Horse Inn messenger points toward Barovia. Village buildings describe barricades, but their actual door states and keys determine access; an accepted briefing does not spawn the threats.

Ashlyn describes Thendrick and Mathilda and seeks the Sunsword. Bring the exact bloody brooch from Mathilda's equipment in the church containment cell for Ashlyn's bracelet. Her thanks name Thendrick, but do not restore either companion or award the separate Lightbringer achievement.

Danovich carries the brittle key for the secret church trapdoor. The hidden containment wall leads to Doru, Thendrick and Mathilda as independently placed enemies. The church, cemetery tunnel and cottage kitchen have falling hazards; be prepared before entering or acting there.

Danovich's bible has pages about the Tome of Strahd, Ireena's adoption and his use of the Liber Blaspheme. Ashlyn's Pelor journal explains the companions' expedition. These are optional clues, without a durable examined-page or learned-topic objective.

Kolyan's body holds the first note. Give it to Ismark for 200,000 copper and the cottage lead; it is consumed despite the narrated toss-back. Ireena can first return it with directions, but that guidance is optional and creates a replacement object.

Push the wrecked cart north of the mansion for the hillside route to the cottage. Hossa and his ambush party are already waiting in the cellar. His different note and ambush plan earns Ismark's green gloves without requiring a prior forged-letter receipt.

Bildrath needs all nine exact trinkets together: hair pin, compass locket, silver spoon, golden wrench, silver horse shoe, gold chalice, engraved electrum coin, engagement ring and blue bell. The reward is the time warp mask; a pile of one kind or wallet currency cannot replace the set.

Parriwimple's five-platinum list is an optional paid clue unavailable under active accounting. The nine physical items have ordinary declared sources around the village and cottage, including the church altar and ghoul grave. Bildrath's delivery does not reopen a defined shop or require clearing every zombie.

Push Mihail's loose grave marker for the cemetery passage to the ghoul grave. One ghast there carries the blue bell. The declared chalice, bible and first note are nested in the altar or body; inventory readiness requires taking offering items out of their containers.

Doru carries the heart of blaspheme for Ephon in the northern lookout post. Ephon awards a brittle Barovia gate key and disappears. The key opens the northern village gates, and a hidden-glen gateway also uses it. One copy may break after one use; the receipt does not stop future zombie resets.

Beyond the northern gates is continued Barovia, where Madam Eva's relic exchange offers the outer Castle Ravenloft gate key. Megosh offers another key exchange at the castle's outer gate. Both contracts belong to continued Barovia despite Megosh's foreign placement. Possession, hints and a local receipt do not award foreign-area discovery.

Enter the hidden bramble opening for the glen. Its two side gateways lead to dimensional corridors returning toward the northern village road and Castle Ravenloft. Their keys differ; the Castle gate key is not Ephon's Barovia key.

Gertruda is a quest object placed in Castle Ravenloft's dark bedchamber. Bring that exact object to Mad Mary for the grim visage of a MaDWoMaN. Mary disappears; the narrated reunion is represented by this delivery, without a separate NPC escort or moved mother-and-daughter pair.

The existing You Strahd Me At Hello achievement is an ordered Doru, Chernovog, Castle Strahd kill campaign with its own legacy tags and eligible nearby group credit. Incomplete tags are cleared at login. Catacomb Strahd forms and skull deliveries are different; the zone journal does not infer this campaign from donated proof.

Directly carry every offering outside equipment and containers. Optional access and earlier receipts guide the intended journey without excluding gifts. Readiness and journal reads award nothing. Four repeatable story/request groups are potential dailies; services and mode-zero retiring contacts remain excluded.

story_mappings.introduction: Five rune masters hold the pieces of Malchor's lost artifact. His museum request is one story: return all five distinct runes together. Suggested questions, current supplies and optional travel preparation do not themselves award achievements.
orientation: The forest and River Moria connect Conyberry, Thundertree and the pond approach to the Tower of Twilight. The five masters hold five different rune kinds; the current delivery accepts supplied runes as well as personally recovered ones.

Ask the amethyst master about the rune, Malchor or artifact. Ask Malchor about the masters and the five rune names. These are guidance topics; each keyword is not an achievement or recorded proof of learning.

From the forest pond approach, the rock path leads to the invisible bridge and the Tower of Twilight. The guardian golem carries a wand of entry. Use, rather than its advertised wave command, is its trigger, but the ordinary reset opens the east passage already.
Follow the tower ramp to the museum. Malchor accepts one amethyst, sapphire, diamond, ruby and emerald rune together. Get them out of containers and remove any worn or held rune before offering.

The currently matched reward is a ruby-encrusted eyepatch. Other reward variants share the same complete offering and have no selection step. The journal counts this recovery once, including an older recorded variant, instead of treating it as five separate commissions.

The concealed tree-dome hole leads to a separate mirror maze with unresolved exit problems. Agatha and her horseshoe/payment lore are not prerequisites or implemented follow-on quests for Malchor. The real golden horseshoes lie elsewhere in the forest; Wicks in the Divine Home accepts them in a separate exchange.
Conyberry farming, Thundertree logging and museum projections are exploration and atmosphere. Their narrated work, healing and rescue suggestions do not implement new local completion receipts.
Quest tracking is available while economic accounting is active. Supply checks show what you carry now; a successful recorded delivery completes this story.

story_mappings.introduction: Find the city inn's local requests, the wizard's independent commissions and the medicine-and-pendant chain. Current supplies, optional preparation and accepted delivery history stay distinct. Supporting maps, medicine, equipment and paid practice grant no extra quest achievements. Active, ready accounting is required.
orientation: The city has ordinary sea-wall, mesa, bay and north/south road approaches. Start with look and exits, then find the inn and market. Arrival discovers a place; it does not complete any named delivery.

The hungry mercenary needs the exact city loaf. The baker stocks it and the inn kitchen has a ground supply. Other food belongs to the homeless child's different, currently unsupported typed-food request.

The inn monk needs three different toy instruments together. The elven child carries the flute, the human the mandolin and the halfling the lyre; two descriptions name the wrong toys. The travelling bard's ordinary loan instruments are not valid substitutes.

The dining-room storyteller signs the large blank book, without requiring the quill mentioned in her dialogue. Inspect an accessible desk in the library; search hidden contents, then take the actual book. Examining, searching and carrying are separate actions.

The inn ranger calls his lost wolf pup Phobos and points under a bed, but the current source is a plant sack. Return the exact pup for belt and cloak. A living pet, follower, generic wolf or pet-shop claim ticket does not substitute.

The inn herbalist explains nightshade and mandrake. Open an accessible plant sack before searching; a successful ordinary search reveals one hidden object at a time, and you still need to take it. Similar sacks can hold different contents, so check the live source.

Bring the two different herbs together to the kitchen alchemist for a maroon vial. That preparation service supports the wounded halfling without adding an achievement. A supplied vial skips the herbs and does not fabricate their gathering or production history.

The wounded halfling wants the vial and the merchant's solid-gold pendant together. The merchant wears the pendant and has two bodyguards; his dialogue refuses help. The wounded halfling's heirloom claim is disputed. Acceptance lets him leave and awards experience and an empty pouch, without an escort or separate healing outcome.

The travelling bard exchanges shared blank paper for a city map. Paper exists in the active world and is declared in desks and the wine merchant's inventory. City directions, level advice and instrument loans remain supporting information, without learned-topic or performance credit.

The sorcerer's stair-bottom portal leads into the twisted tower's first chamber, where a glowing bookshelf holds the twisted-tower wizard's crumpled note. The return portal leads to the park. The note commission, magical-text commission and foreign-dagger commission are independent.

The conjurer-tower bookshelf supplies the magical text book. Royal-bedroom chest stock is another declaration, but its loaded lock has no ordinary key. The text reward is a tome and raven feather quill; other blank, signed or spell books are different items.

The twisted-tower wizard accepts Tezcat's bloody sacrificial dagger for a disguise kit, illusion robe and potion. A foreign Tezcazul carries the proof. This local delivery does not prove your own defeat of that carrier or use of the reward powers.

The dwarven warrior improves four exact ordinary weapon families. Two same-named two-handed swords are alternative inputs for one support service. Unwield the selected weapon before offering; practice, generic weapon names and other finished weapons do not substitute.

The apprentice sorcerer's one-platinum wand purchase and several city paid services are unavailable until their payments can be completed safely. A visible fee or available cash is not a completed purchase.

Dungeon exploration has a brick switch, hidden passages and actual keyed doors. Push the brick at the jail stair landing to unblock its eastern secret route, then search for the passage. This access action is not an inn-quest achievement. Rooftops and drop-offs have real falling hazards.

Exact supplied proofs remain valid. Current item checks do not prove first acquisition, personal recovery, combat, search success, learned topics, healing, practice or travel. Only accepted native delivery receipts complete these eight independent outcomes; active sources and recipient appearances still need qualification.

contacts.description: Lynstar is in the pit beneath the Butsu village, reached through the well or termite tunnels. She makes six distinct legendary instruments and six matching epic upgrades. Each epic upgrade consumes Retribution and she leaves afterward; her sister's full-set request is an unfinished lead.
contacts.name: Lynstar

contacts.description: Dromis stands at the western savannah entrance. Ask about savannah for the tribal legend, or his other book topics for distant lore. The journal does not yet track his predicted chief-defeat and M'Bele appearance.
contacts.name: Dromis

contacts.description: The Tukluk chief in the northwestern village describes the conflict with the Butsus. Ask about contest. The journal does not award a tribal victory or M'Bele appearance for defeating him.
contacts.name: The Tukluk Chief

contacts.description: The Tukluk shaman in the northwestern village requests three tusks or three gazelle skins. These pay separate curio and sleeves outcomes; mixing the kinds does not qualify. His claimed aid to the tribe has no recorded battle stage.
contacts.name: a Tukluk shaman

contacts.description: Kylian and his two companions start at the western entrance. Ask about roc. He accepts the exact tailfeather for an insignia and 10,000 copper, but that delivery does not require your own kill or dispatch a homeward escort.
contacts.name: Kylian Brightstar

contacts.description: Ange follows Kylian and offers companion lore and a memorial response. Her dialogue is informational and does not award a separate quest achievement.
contacts.name: Ange de Morte

contacts.description: Luncke follows Kylian and offers companion lore. Conversation does not prove a battle or journey back to Edgeland.
contacts.name: Luncke

contacts.description: Sprithnog works in the laboratory beneath the huge baobab. His plaque requests lion bones. The directly carried bones earn monocles; the declared stone golems are separate ordinary stock.
contacts.name: Sprithnog the Alchemist

contacts.description: The Watcher starts in the savannah and may wander. Ask about contest or interfere for the sealed Kahir burial. He accepts the exact essence for a cloak and leaves; no personal hunt or M'Bele appearance is inferred.
contacts.name: the Watcher of the Contest

contacts.description: The roc in the northeastern clearing carries the tailfeather sought by Kylian. A first pickup or personal kill requires separate source evidence; the native reward accepts a supplied feather.
contacts.name: a roc

contacts.description: Ordinary elephants gather at the watering hole; two tusk stock declarations are attached to them. Not every elephant carries a tusk.
contacts.name: an elephant

contacts.description: The bull elephant at the watering hole has the third tusk declaration. The shaman needs three current tusks together.
contacts.name: a bull elephant

contacts.description: A large gazelle near the center of the savannah carries one declared skin. Its ordinary follower has another; a third is on a follower at the dusty clearing.
contacts.name: a large gazelle

contacts.description: Follower gazelles have two of the three skin declarations. Other gazelles need not carry a skin, and supplied exact skins are accepted by the shaman.
contacts.name: a gazelle

contacts.description: The proud lion near the central savannah carries the one declared pile of lion bones for Sprithnog. Other lions do not gain this stock merely by sharing the species name.
contacts.name: a proud lion

contacts.description: The ghostly Kahir host is declared behind the secret, closed wall beneath the termite mound. The essence is one stock declaration among five hosts; it is not a generated death reward for each host.
contacts.name: the ghostly remnants of the Kahir tribe

contacts.description: The Butsu chief is ordinary stock in the southern village. The tribal-war legend has no reviewed victory or god-summoning endpoint. The village well and termite tunnels lead toward Lynstar's pit.
contacts.name: the Butsu chief

story_mappings.introduction: Meet the savannah's tribes, rocchasers, hidden researcher and Watcher. Their named requests have exact delivery outcomes. Lynstar's equipment trades remain distinct supporting services, while the sister and tribal-war legends are unfinished leads. Active, ready accounting is required.
orientation: Enter from the western surface trail to meet Dromis and Kylian's companions. Ask Dromis about savannah and Kylian about roc. Topics explain lore; hearing a keyword does not award an achievement.

The roc in the northeastern clearing carries the tailfeather for Kylian. He pays 10,000 copper and an insignia, accepting supplied proof as well. His gratitude does not record your own kill or send the companions home.

The Tukluk shaman in the northwestern village accepts three tusks together for a curio, or three gazelle skins together for sleeves. These are different requests and rewards; a mixed batch or one of each does not qualify. Neither delivery records the defeat of the Butsus.

Three tusks are declared on elephants at the watering hole. The three skin declarations belong to a large gazelle and its follower near the center and another follower in the dusty clearing. Exact stock is limited; every animal of a species need not carry a quest part.

A proud lion near the central savannah carries the one declared pile of lion bones. Descend through the huge baobab, pass the falling shaft and follow the underground tunnels west to Sprithnog. His laboratory plaque requests the bones for monocles; ordinary golem stock is separate.

Ask the Watcher about contest or interfere. Enter the giant termite mound and find the secret, closed wall into the Kahir burial chamber. One essence declaration is carried by a ghostly host among five. No item key opens that wall. Bring the current essence to the Watcher for his cloak and departure.

Lynstar is declared in the pit beneath the Butsu village, rather than on the village paths. The well drops down and has no upward exit. A secret, closed western connection links the pit to the termite tunnels, providing a separate approach and way out.

Each Mitashi katana pays a different legendary instrument: Shadows Breath → lyre; The North Wind → drums; Divine Fury → horn; Celestial Dragon → flute; Torrential Rain → mandolin; The Lotus Blossom → harp. These are six separate equipment services, not interchangeable collection terminals.

Kunji Pishida in the abandoned Mitashi warehouse basement accepts all six distinct katanas together for Retribution and leaves. Giving a katana to Lynstar instead spends that copy. A supplied Retribution can skip the Kunji exchange, but a receipt cannot replace the sword after it is consumed.

Each epic upgrade needs one current Retribution plus its matching legendary instrument. Lynstar leaves after an upgrade, so additional epic instruments require another available appearance or supplied instruments. Repeated lyre wording in dialogue does not change the six exact recipes.

Using only these fresh native recipes to make all six epic instruments consumes seven copies of each original katana: one set for the six base instruments and six sets for six Retributions. Kunji and Lynstar each need six available appearances. Declared cap-one sword stock and active generation must be qualified; gifts can shorten this preparation.

Lynstar says her sister in the Drakenwood Hostel wants the six epic instruments. That full-set request is an unfinished lead with no supported ending in the journal. Each instrument trade remains available separately when Lynstar and the supplies are present.

Dromis predicts M'Bele will appear after a chief is defeated. The journal does not yet track that ending. Tukluk deliveries and Kahir proof have their own rewards without awarding tribal victory or a god-summoning achievement.

The North Wind katana and the Watcher's cloak also pay a separate nine-item relic request on the Plane of Air. That foreign recipient owns its own reward and receipt; one current item cannot pay both uses. Local hints do not discover or complete the foreign story.

Instrument use belongs to the normal bard system: equip the correct instrument and know an appropriate song. A trade receipt records the equipment exchange, rather than learned songs or a successful performance. Remove equipment before offering it in a quest.

Readiness shows current exact carried quantities. Supplies, recipient appearances and ordinary travel need active-world qualification. Item names, NORENT restrictions and animal stock do not prove freshness or personal hunting; gifts are valid unless a future objective explicitly requires personal recovery.

story_mappings.introduction: The Black Pearl owns a scattered dragonslayer expedition as well as a wreck full of undead. Its intended campaign travels from Tharnadia through Caer Tannad, Twin Towers, Turopolis, Pharr Valley, Evermeet, the circus, Verspin, the Moonshaes, Newhaven and Kimodril. The reviewed source currently leaves the campaign contacts and several supplies in an exitless holding room; deeper placement repairs are required before a complete ordinary journey is available.
orientation: The intended expedition begins with Warthehr's scrawled invitation at Tharnadia's Tower of the Cleric. That invitation and the lost Turopolis sewer fragment currently have no ordinary source. The campaign's named contacts, animal proofs and first four wreck keys are currently declared only in an exitless holding room.

The fragment leads are: thief in Caer Tannad; farmer's son in Twin Towers; Turopolis sewer recovery; Gartham in Pharr Valley; Milerg's white wolf request on Evermeet; ogre-gnome's yo-yo request at the circus; Derimous's four different horns in Verspin; Lyle and Abal's Moonshae letters and scepter. These are intended destinations, awaiting placement and source repair.

Warthehr replaces the original Gartham, hunter and Ffolk fragments with three different pieces bearing the same name. The Gartham report also awards 100,000 copper through the supported item-and-wallet reward path. The hunter report provides a letter to Lyle; the Ffolk report provides a letter to Jyarl.

Warthehr's letter to Lyle produces the letter to Abal. Abal supplies a heavy iron chest key and a separate shimmering key for the Moonshae king's secret door. The royal scepter and trapped chest have no ordinary source in the reviewed data. Abal's later reply to Lyle is a different letter and produces Lyle's fragment. No recorded theft, royal vengeance or restored hunting title follows from delivery prose.

Jyarl's addressed letter produces the humming hilt. Telrar needs nine distinct pieces together: thief, farmer, sewer, Milerg and circus fragments; the three Warthehr replacement fragments; and the hilt. Eight copies of one fragment cannot substitute. Optional producer history helps explain sources without replacing spent pieces or excluding a supplied complete set.

Showing each recovered piece to Warthehr supplies recorded guidance. These returns preserve the item kind while replacing the offered object. They remain visible services without extra quest achievements. The native exchanges are independent; their narrated order does not enforce every earlier stage.

The intended dragon finale is Ghalasax's baby-dragon skin for six large and six small gems. The reviewed Ghalasax is still in the holding room; the huge skeletal dragon aboard the wreck is different. The final delivery accepts supplied skin without proving personal sword construction, weapon use or a kill. The fixed gems go to the offering actor rather than being allocated by current party size.

The barbarian, gnome and dwarf hunters offer separate large/small gem equipment trades. Giving has no class prerequisite, though equipment restrictions and experience caps still apply. The patron's five-platinum gadget purchase is unavailable under active accounting; a supplied gadget can feed the farmer's independent request. Services do not add quest achievements.

The wreck has an outward exit to the surface mountains, but no reciprocal ordinary entrance was found. Its permanent mobile hunter-ship entrance is disabled. Early grating and door keys come from spirits currently in the holding room; several later doors are locked without a matching key, so access needs explicit repair and live qualification.

Inside the wreck, cargo rooms lead up to cabins and guard quarters. Two concealed side closets reset locked. The guard captain's small bone key fits the northern secured route despite its unusual object type. The roof trapdoor resets closed and must be opened. Long John Silver, the alchemist, navigator and skeletal dragon are separate encounters; their remains, rod and broken compass have no reviewed campaign finale.

Carry all offering items directly, outside containers and equipment. A committed hand-in records that exact delivery once. Inventory readiness and optional earlier receipts award nothing. Mode-zero disappearing contacts have limited shared availability; a daily candidate count does not promise a currently reachable contact, a stock refresh or a completed campaign.

story_mappings.introduction: Explore the Surface Realm: seventeen independent story outcomes and six support rows, including regional deliveries, competing trophies and the labyrinth's exact five-material finale. Active, ready accounting is required.
orientation: The Surface Realm is one large discovered zone covering many continental regions. Use nearby contacts and the exact zone journal command to follow encountered requests. Discovery supplies regional guidance; it does not reveal every contact or require exploring every grid room.

Most stories are independent deliveries. Native exchanges accept exact materials supplied by another player. Current possession, personal source recovery and durable accepted delivery are separate facts; inspecting this journal grants no history or keyword achievement.

The labyrinth campaign has competing offerings: four different warden trophies buy a book, while each warden asks for a separate labyrinthmaster heart to buy one elemental locket. A single heart cannot serve four consumers, and killing a warden can remove that appearance as a locket recipient.

The mystic's finale requires the book plus fire, water, earth and air lockets together. These are five current item kinds, not five earlier receipts. The air locket has copied fire keywords; the actual object kind distinguishes it. Earlier personal campaign receipts are optional rather than enforced.

The ornate gemmed reward key opens the downwards tomb door in the forest beyond the surface approach. The neighboring transparent gateway has another key and a different continuation. Local hand-in credit does not establish later access or foreign quest completion.

Opposing raider bounties and elemental prophet requests remain separate stories. Their pledge or victory prose supplies a role-playing choice without durable allegiance, permanent world defeat or mutually exclusive branch enforcement.

The tundra hunter has a five-fang equipment service and a paw story. Complete desired necklace work before the paw exchange retires that appearance. The rewarded white potion can serve a separate nomad request; a supplied potion qualifies without the producer's earlier receipt.

Five nightcrawler claws, a witchdoctor totem, three blood crystals and two independent wyvern-egg requests use exact current materials. Kills, worn items and earlier deliveries cannot replace those supplies. One egg is consumed by one recipient; narrated study or rebirth has no extra recorded endpoint.

Three fishing-market rows group independent support barters without quest achievements or dailies. Breale bass and normal large bass are distinct kinds. A valid supplied fish satisfies a barter without manufacturing a first personal catch.

The gland/bracer and four-crystal wand recipes also require coins. Their mixed settlement remains guarded while accounting is active. Preparation hints do not prove wallet readiness. The bracer has no ordinary loaded repeatable source found in this review.

Private dispersal hubs, capped proof, roaming contacts and 99-percent campaign appearances need actual availability qualification. A starting room or reset declaration is a lead; do not promise that a quest recipient or every material is currently present.

Treant death creates wood, the highwayman guardian can summon help, and the shadow rift chooses its destination by racewar context. Accepted source, helper and confirmed-travel events are needed before these mechanics can become recorded stages. The old devil death invasion is commented out.

Ports, travel buildings and class teachers have separate service and travel mechanics. Epic purchases remain unavailable while accounting is active. The old descend continuation is disabled; possession of campaign rewards does not make it a playable quest.

Directional boundary access and foreign source or continuation receipts retain their own area ownership. Two surface exits reference an unloaded room and have a targeted repair plan; neither discovery nor receipt tests certify a played access journey.
